Fellow Conservative,

Are we going to continue to be a country of law and order, _**or are we fine becoming a borderless, anarchic society with no rules and even less order?**_

I have no idea what the Biden Administration is thinking most days, but how in the world did they think **WELDING OPEN** flood gates along the U.S.-Mexican border was a good idea?

_**“Each of the 114 gates in Arizona, which have been open for nearly two months, has 12-foot doors wide enough for a motorcycle to drive through. Smugglers drive busloads of migrants to the Mexican side of the border, where they get off and simply walk into the US.”**_
**We thought the agents were going to tell us something,** ” one Ecuadorean migrant said. “**But we just walked in,** ” according to the _New York Post._

**As someone who has personally pulled the dead bodies of immigrants out of ditches, I cannot express my dismay at Biden’s failure to secure the border. **

As a candidate for the U.S. Senate and a Sheriff in my own right, **[I’m putting together a petition to send to President Biden demanding action at the border.](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=1ad1d9e51a0a4236ba4c896dc99b2950&_e=zhpSozt3zowmN_-UGMBmfcf3Q9BnbKXVJ3VebYllFg23cfWFfdXoLOSYu7gL-LvHVIzX4ObpPSnABSTCIBLP9p4Q_vSun_MQPu4KC8OQpV6UFOnuWqiww46ns8PEeroUPalWAtKOfjqbu7RD71exu-3f4Tl6EnQR8g1ErzzE_60jin6yvaGf_ifxm6g6TaeoL1snlvbV0VPe83tvbCbM_c6yh1RhNVHVLT3VHfKCf5S3y58OAfgRAkl6pcZnsdrM0M0RcA9y5U8FhwZoEOVJUIYIbJiBqf9n9NMvjnVE-mbzpVm68RNqHNsiAwf3AEWFdmZ3wMujfzsS4EKLfo85-AdHHbt1RIEvQuBTtBD27TieV1YcfuaO97BkT3xWhyYG-IgqxNoKKMaq6kqRYHznAg%3D%3D)

That's a huge sign of our strength, but we still have ground to make up.

Calvert got a head start on fundraising, and thanks to his special interest and corporate PAC allies, he currently has more cash than we do. Much more. Missouri is short on leadership. The Show-Me State has stagnated economically and fallen behind other big red conservative states because of a Swamp in Jefferson City that refuses to accomplish what the People desperately need. Our culture is in the midst of a war of ideas on the role of government—we need a wartime leader with the backbone and willingness to take on the powerful special interests in our state that are profiting at the expense of the People. I will be that leader, and unlike many politicians, I've **always** done what I said I was going to do.

Democrat Political operative and South Florida Tax Attorney Lawrence Caplan has [filed a laws](https://substack.com/redirect/8eaf3386-4901-46d4-9cec-fa1cb79ea1f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)uit challenging President Trump's ability to run for President in 2024, citing the 14th Amendment. Caplan cites Section 3 of the 14th Amendment, and is alleging that Trump's "involvement" in January 6th, 2021 as his logic. It is worth noting that the 14th Amendment's "disqualification clause" was created in response to the Civil War, and it was only established as a means to bar individuals who joined the Confederacy from ever serving in state or federal office. Caplan's suit was filed on August 24th, 2023, just one day before President Trump's arrest in Fulton County, Georgia, and contains a lot of misinformation and several spelling and grammatical errors, including the misspelling of his own address. According to the 14th Amendment, those who "have engaged in insurrection or rebellion" against the government cannot hold office.
In the lawsuit, Caplan stated,
> "The bottom line here is that President Trump both engaged in an insurrection and also gave aid and comfort to other individuals who were engaging in such actions, within the clear meaning of those terms as defined in Section Three of the 14th Amendment. Assuming that the public record to date is accurate, and we have no evidence to the contrary, Trump is no longer eligible to seek the office of the President of the United States, or of any other state of the Union."
In response to the lawsuit, a spokesperson from President Trump's campaign [said](https://substack.com/redirect/806c2ff9-97b9-4fd0-96b7-06ad70e80b56?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg),
> "We look forward to its prompt dismissal, to an award of legal sanctions against the plaintiff and to receiving full payment from him of all of our legal fees responding to this meritless, bad faith case."
Caplan has a history of filing litigation in an attempt to impact American Presidential elections. In 2000, Caplan [went to court over Dick Cheney's ](https://substack.com/redirect/d8554d9f-e6ea-43e2-869e-f58feddc75ce?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)last-minute registration as a Wyoming voter when Cheney was on the ballot as George W. Bush's Vice Presidential pick. Caplan argued that as a longtime Dallas taxpayer and voter, Dick Cheney was ineligible to vote in Wyoming. A Dallas federal judge eventually threw out Caplan's lawsuit.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..I0zabjn6dWu2kE5ki49aXqAfyy-qE5YU-nv-QPTZOQM?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=136574968)
Perhaps feeling slighted from his legal defeat, Caplan launched a new initiative in order to influence future presidential elections. After the 2000 Presidential election, he founded an internet based election effort called "Operation Snowbird". The since-removed website encouraged part-time Florida residents (snowbirds) from traditionally Democrat states such as New York and New Jersey to change their voter registration to Florida in order to entertain Caplan's theory that the presidential election of 2000 would have been Al Gore's to win if Snowbird northerners who temporarily reside in Florida would have instead voted in Florida. The Bush/Cheney ticket won the state of Florida in 2000 during the Presidential election by a mere 537 votes. Regarding Operation Snowbird, Caplan previously stated, "If we could get 10,000 votes to switch, it would be worth it".
Caplan's current suit is viewed as a long shot by legal analysts, as no precedent has been set for a case of this type. None of the January 6th defendants have been charged with participating in an insurrection, and President Trump has not been convicted of inciting or participating in an insurrection. Caplan's suit appears to be more of a political stunt and an attempt to get media attention, as opposed to a valid legal challenge.

---|---|---
In addition to his legal work, Caplan also works as [the President ](https://substack.com/redirect/6eb41cd2-0d44-4733-927d-a409c1d88c21?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)of the [Sequoia Group](https://substack.com/redirect/103eebca-8c6b-42d9-9929-71997ea76504?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg), which describes itself as a Florida Offshore and Domestic Asset Protection Specialist Company, located in Boca Raton. Sequoia Group lists its specialties as offshore investing and limiting tax liability. Caplan's history as an attorney appears to be quite limited to offshore trusts. While he is currently licensed to practice law in Florida, he recently lost his license to practice law in California after it was suspended.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/6ec16ae2-2e5e-47a0-937a-8fab90fa1241?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|

---|---|---
Outside of his Sequioa Group employment and his long list of TV game show appearances, Caplan retains a limited web presence and limited social media footprint.
[Upgrade to paid](https://substack..I0zabjn6dWu2kE5ki49aXqAfyy-qE5YU-nv-QPTZOQM?&utm_medium=email&utm_source=subscribe-widget&utm_content=136574968)
Caplan was a Who Wants to Be A Millionaire contestant in 2000, winning $32,000.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/1168e3fe-5134-4d39-91c2-d721988581e9?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Lawrence also made three appearances on Jeopardy in 1984 under the name Larry Caplan before his streak ended. However, unfortunately for Caplan, he was never given the opportunity to appear in the most coveted TV shows of all, Donald Trump's Emmy award nominated "The Apprentice", which could explain why Caplan has such animosity for show host and 45th President of the United States.
**And, in case Lawrence Caplan is reading this article, let me take this moment to invite him onto my own show, "Who Wants To Be Loomered"... **
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/806b2b17-cdd9-4be4-91ea-891d914f2c1a?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
Using Section 3 of the 14 Amendment as a potential legal strategy to prevent Donald Trump from seeking the nomination in 2024 has been discussed by numerous Leftist and RINO pundits as a way to spook the American people into not voting for President Trump, and as a way to intimidate GOP voters ahead of the GOP convention in which President Trump is facing a crowded primary full of RINO, GOP establishment career politicians, opportunists, and ingrate grifters who are participating in the persecution of President Trump as he continues to increase his massive lead as the favored GOP candidate. Given the fact that this strategy has been discussed as a threat, but never promoted any actual legal action, it further begs the question as to why a gameshow chasing tax attorney is the person who has decided to file suit against Donald Trump. Election law appears to be substantially outside of Caplan's area of experience and legal expertise, as his Florida based law firm is solely focused on limiting tax liability for its clients.
Caplan also has a limited history of political contributions, according to the financial transparency site opensecrets.org. No activity has been listed for Caplan since 2011, but all recorded donations have been made to Democrat candidates who ran for office, including former US Senate candidates Bill Nelson and Harry Reid.
| [](https://substack.com/redirect/66cd2d62-6729-4911-911a-380e6f0dbb34?j=eyJ1IjoiMWh2cjYwIn0.VBabVq-VHATXCJqsddI7uMpdiTm0WkVanRDZfvCWMkg)|
---|---|---
While it is certainly odd that a fame hungry tax attorney with limited online activity is the person who is leading the effort in Florida to file frivolous litigation to stop President Trump from being on the ballot in Florida in 2024, it isn't surprising to see a man who hides money for wealthy clients in offshore accounts as a full time profession using duplicitous tactics to interfere in the 2024 Presidential election. Surely, among helping the rich and famous avoid paying taxes and assisting them in hiding their assets, Lawrence Caplan has also likely become an expert in hiding and misrepresenting his own activity and associations throughout his part time job of pretend, dollar store political strategist.

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Today's deadline, with its unnecessarily hardline consequences, will only make that worse when hundreds, if not thousands, lose their jobs and are denied unemployment benefits. It also threatens public safety by reducing our police forces at a time when crime is already rising. People feel unsafe. They are afraid of what criminals will do when there are even fewer law enforcement officers to respond. And they are worried about people's chances of survival if there aren't enough first responders to help in an emergency. The governor underestimates the potential impact of his actions.

“Coercion, intimidation, threats and public shaming are not tactics a leader should be using against the people. The governor's obvious disdain for those who are choosing to lose their jobs rather than compromise their right to make their own medical decisions is unhelpful. He is dividing the public – segregating us and turning people against each other. Yesterday, even unvaccinated health-care workers were heroes. Today, they become villains in the governor's narrative."

Read the full statement. (https://jtwilcox.houserepublicans.wa.gov/2021/10/18/republican-leaders-todays-vaccine-deadline-threatens-critical-services-public-safety/?fbclid=IwAR3WxI9H29hbbmfbZhdkDS9QjqdVd2TIRCdjNjUkUlLdeThtbUjK_WBWJuw)
Smiley Campaign Shows Grassroots Support In Latest Fundraising Quarter
Tiffany Smiley is fighting hard to retire Patty Murray and her latest fundraising numbers show not only has Tiffany raised more than $1.6 million but she also has unequivocal grassroots support, with over 10,000 donors from Washington State. Flipping a U.S. Senate seat is hard work but Tiffany has shown in the only 5 months since starting her campaign, that she is a force to be reckoned with. Learn more about how Tiffany stands on the issues here (https://www.smileyforwashington.com/issues) .

| While you might think of him as Congressman, Representative, or just Adam — to me, he’s dad.
# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=3640%2E5257348%2EZdS3Cs)
Derek — it’s Lexi! Adam’s daughter. Hope you’re having a great summer!
And while you might think of him as Congressman, Representative, or just Adam — to me, he’s dad.
[](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2023_abs_em.G4DTRv&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20230830_PM2_V1_S1&email=&t=4&akid=3640%2E5257348%2EZdS3Cs)
My dad has been on the road this summer, traveling across California meeting with as many people as humanly possible. From county fairs to union halls, parades to picnics, I’m having a hard time keeping up with his busy schedule!
He’s always been this way: Growing up, he would tell us all these stories about the people he'd met from his district and their concerns about their jobs, their families, and all of the things that they wanted to be different in our country — what mattered most to them.
My first thought when hearing those stories was always that it must be so hard to listen to those stories every day and have people expect so much from you as just one person. **But my dad would always tell us that it was the best part of the job. The chance to hear people's struggles and honest concerns and work to fix them — and make their lives better.**
That's what truly and genuinely motivates him at his core — and that’s what I know he will bring to the Senate, if we can elect him there. The humanity and the unrelenting passion to change people's lives for the better, and make our country and our world a better place to live in.

body:
Peter,

Congressman Anthony D'Esposito has always stood firm as an advocate for the safety and prosperity of our communities.

With the crucial end-of-the-month deadline rapidly approaching, we are rallying support [https://winred.despositoforcongress.com/d-esposito-for-new-york/email?utm_source=email&utm_medium=appeal&utm_content=link&utm_campaign=2+Days+Left+Are+You+In+Email] to ensure he can continue his dedicated efforts to represent our needs.

Recent events underscore the challenges our communities face.

A particularly concerning scene unfolded when a girl's youth soccer game took place a mere few feet away from tents housing single migrant men. Such situations emphasize the need to revisit our policies and address the pressing issues our communities confront daily.

Leaders like Secretary Alejandro Mayorkas, Governor Kathy Hochul, and the NYC Mayor must prioritize and make decisions that genuinely reflect the well-being and safety of all New Yorkers.

With just two days to meet our end-of-the-month fundraising goal, your support is paramount in ensuring Congressman D'Esposito continues his tireless work for New York's best interests.

Are you in? Your contribution, no matter the size, will significantly impact our mission. Here's what your donation can accomplish: [https://winred.despositoforcongress.com/d-esposito-for-new-york/email?utm_source=email&utm_medium=appeal&utm_content=link&utm_campaign=2+Days+Left+Are+You+In+Email]

→ $25 [https://winred.despositoforcongress.com/d-esposito-for-new-york/email?amount=25&utm_source=email&utm_medium=appeal&utm_content=amount+link&utm_campaign=2+Days+Left+Are+You+In+Email] can assist in reaching out to 100 constituents about pressing local concerns.

→ $50 [https://winred.despositoforcongress.com/d-esposito-for-new-york/email?amount=50&utm_source=email&utm_medium=appeal&utm_content=amount+link&utm_campaign=2+Days+Left+Are+You+In+Email] will fund a community town hall where residents can voice their safety concerns.

→ $100 [https://winred.despositoforcongress.com/d-esposito-for-new-york/email?amount=100&utm_source=email&utm_medium=appeal&utm_content=amount+link&utm_campaign=2+Days+Left+Are+You+In+Email] aids in drafting policy suggestions to state and city officials.

→ $250 [https://winred.despositoforcongress.com/d-esposito-for-new-york/email?amount=250&utm_source=email&utm_medium=appeal&utm_content=amount+link&utm_campaign=2+Days+Left+Are+You+In+Email] or more can drastically amplify our campaign outreach and mobilization, ensuring our voice resonates throughout the state.

DONATE ANY AMOUNT → [https://winred.despositoforcongress.com/d-esposito-for-new-york/email?utm_source=email&utm_medium=appeal&utm_content=other+button&utm_campaign=2+Days+Left+Are+You+In+Email]

Together, we can ensure that our streets remain safe and our children play without any underlying fears.

Sincerely,

Team D'Esposito

Special Session, Model Policies, and More
| | | | [](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001EIHh8K-ZBZUWCQHuGvjLJUjrY8VdiEJa4VIAEFCpKPHxDSgwgx-9TVYqJnuRL8FDXhoNIc0GR_F235x1RjTutPiqL0jUoUGdrw6M7vZN4DBCFr8y2Q_kTeY7PaDaOgxDBdvuzSix7wuUVfF8qC-BHv3KMFQxJv8lwGZAuoiPlrU=&c=sZQMheI_laXR3g0MvmUXkG_jy6tm1l3gaZwv2r1bGWNKj3k5kWqSrA==&ch=M-bKAuzJG_4L-ycQ39ZJBXOQIOzBRPhImpQjA6Q7E4TBLd2vKo9rPQ==)

Dear Friends,

Many conservative parents are wondering why their children no longer share their conservative values and yet are continuing to send their kids to public school indoctrination camps.

We have good conservative teachers in public schools, but their hands are tied thanks to legislation passed in 2020 by the Democrat controlled General Assembly that have only increased the attack on conservative Christian values.

Local school systems are legally required to comply with these laws and it makes me sick to see the indoctrination snuck into every aspect of a student's curriculum without parental consent.

The Virginia Dept. of Education issued Model Policies on how to handle gender dysphoria. Among the guidelines, is that parents need to be notified if their child wants a different pronoun. Another important section of the Model Policies says biological boys need to play sports on the boys' team. Those are good policies. But the Superintendent of Public Schools in Fairfax County, Virginia's largest school system, [issued a statement](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001EIHh8K-ZBZUWCQHuGvjLJUjrY8VdiEJa4VIAEFCpKPHxDSgwgx-9TRXmca8sjZWgNdWXGfd5leOSRA-Ali9VBEyqT7OAwca7ReEaiqSHn-pjYZeLG_Cf7aaeAZn6tq_-T3euYaDvqXLbWHEJST1MPqDMgmwpxKVfF3LmjBqkYONTZUgD8NyXgg==&c=sZQMheI_laXR3g0MvmUXkG_jy6tm1l3gaZwv2r1bGWNKj3k5kWqSrA==&ch=M-bKAuzJG_4L-ycQ39ZJBXOQIOzBRPhImpQjA6Q7E4TBLd2vKo9rPQ==) saying they won't follow the Model Policies. They don't have the discretion to do so, but the liberals in Fairfax don't care about the law.

The administration state wants complete compliance and they are dead set on taking away your God given parental rights so they can raise and indoctrinate your children.

[In Maryland](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001EIHh8K-ZBZUWCQHuGvjLJUjrY8VdiEJa4VIAEFCpKPHxDSgwgx-9TRXmca8sjZWg5wpTd8mtxmhCPNptVO6yBCcwL2qB4yU2y8Xzesx1yVz1e0uO5wu0_44sUEMnrPeRTf6mNiqo2cQFXcuOqrdRfAUcbIITWBxESF4eYpnn8Giq-aMubKjn9WN2jHsjuzOUXHkwRxZDPub7xlIzTWi6rNOMTFdB3GETcNj0JDsRYVFVGbYI582qBvjdcYUJQoV2i5QseipHyxuw9M2a4mg8UbuFu1IdFHI0fAThqiyRJD_qI7C4yZ0pwdUsmB2QWWcacJ59P9KDiL3aYtIDSaVM-w19JB0Tsw7l&c=sZQMheI_laXR3g0MvmUXkG_jy6tm1l3gaZwv2r1bGWNKj3k5kWqSrA==&ch=M-bKAuzJG_4L-ycQ39ZJBXOQIOzBRPhImpQjA6Q7E4TBLd2vKo9rPQ==), parents can't opt their kids out of being taught sexual content that is inappropriate for young students.

After everything I've witnessed over the past 8 years as a Senator fighting this evil agenda I can tell you one thing. I wouldn't put my kids in public school.

Wake up friends. Public schools are NOT the same as when we were going through public schools. There is no such thing as a neutral education.

We've been fighting in the legislature for school choice for decades but the Democrats keep shutting that down. It's time for parents to pull their kids out of public schools so they lose funding. Is it a sacrifice for you financially? Yep. But aren't your kids worth it?

The General Assembly has been called back to Richmond for a Special Session to be held on Wednesday, September 6, to finish the budget. I am looking forward to debating the merits of this budget compromise and voting based on what is best for my constituents.

Tuesday of next week is the Chesterfield VA Tea Party monthly meeting. This is the night before Special Session begins, so it is a great opportunity to hear your feedback on the new budget. We'll be at Great American Ranch in Midlothian, join us!

## Hurricane Idalia Hits Florida
Hundreds of thousands of Florida residents are without power [in the aftermath](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD2P4yAQQH-N3WHhwZ8FxTXucu2V1hgGe04EIiBh8-9X2Xq7J73m6f277Tdkz-H8i3fSxcUdTeEX7XIRqhegdmitdkRAqiXdT6saln5ZVHtpM8MB67TacTJoJgnSHG42DmFc3Tq5ljVIUHJRvVxHGKFz4zGMc2-tG0aUh2oGSZZLTN3_yKFc5Pw7vih1Jt5br69SHrlRfxrYGthqrZ2LX4Fq_vgGtmduYLueKbHBQIItekbhMViH3gvnY2KL4uBTHBSsMFjojOktlCgUsihXfGYMNovKHy7iESulNmn7qOw952luBnnekf1PUvn90HcAAAD__62uayw) of Hurricane Idalia, which touched down over the Gulf Coast early Wednesday morning. The storm brought winds that roared up to 130 mph and surges that reached several feet, making it a Category 3 storm and flooding roadways and many homes in Florida's [Big Bend](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGO6yAQheGnsTsiYMDGBcVt0uW2W1oDM8SzInZE2ET79qtsveXR1xz9H5f1glJlv_7HG8dejhVzlyevOigwysJqR4qF2TKMHM20gAsmBBi36MnmYsIUSp4pvSE5s7hCi8YJUxglWm1BBzB68dbbU_HJ-dkQFedRJxicZpJ-tNPnIXvfuNTv48ntlI_bWOPW-_0xwL_Bngd7xvvOr8eb3qN1yZUHey71aEKotq_WJOPOSgiroEpyVYl3UoYK5GIysIZlRiaXyjI7JOcmD2TGFun-klrlMc2D09cbSv290P8u8hMAAP__-MZhXQ). Two people have died, thus far. In addition to flooding and power outages, many homeowners are contending with looters bent on taking advantage of their vulnerable circumstances. Some people have dealt with the threat by posting signs that read, "[You loot, We shoot](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGu4yAQAL8Gd7aWXYhxQXENXa690iIG4j0RYwEX6_7-Ka9-_Ugzmj_39e458_H87V_R9lRWv3V-xxXMSHJEWnEINsWIkYZo5W0hZaQxNOxWLiktBLd500AGYQszSD8jBf9IyxwGtghIYEjColHjlPRD6VmGkJT28CChIAbupU5_Cx99jyn_L-9Yp628hmz33s8m6JdAJ9Bd1zWdJXPnrXwAge6IVxPoPhaBDoxARyDQhdj80bmNl69HG_d_tfLmjzienLN_xtrGlEvl4EcAKUkrNVQbzotz5nabhYLny3P-7ug_b_kKAAD__wPLYiI)." By 11 am on Wednesday, Idalia had dropped to Category 1 and moved into Georgia with winds of 90 mph.
## Budget Standoff Brewing in Congress
Lawmakers are working to agree on a federal budget before the September 30th deadline and the looming threat of a government shutdown, but some Republicans [are unconcerned](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskLGO6yAURL8GOiJ8gYALite4y2u3tIi5hLvCJjIk1v79Kq63m9EUo3O-bvMtUKHt8T-s6Huqc1g6vXGWTqhBgJqBR58QARVHP1xHpd3gnOLZj2rUwSwoF-cWY0apjQ0QrzaMCpyznDxIUNKpQY4GDFySuWtjhxiTNkHeFdMSI_W6X74rbT1jKj_1jftlqSsvPvf-bEz9YzAxmHrGTKV8NgZTritueLQzvhoymPRgrXNOnF0sdWu4v8OHpolUaO_ioJ5Fy68e67GJVsUdBXUGE999fB5UCrWrZVo-1kDnE-9_S_kNAAD__6SXY1E) with the prospect of not making a deal in time.

House conservatives like Rep. Bob Good (R-VA) and Rep. Ralph Norman (R-SC) would rather see parts of the federal government grind to a halt than be allowed to spend tax-payer dollars in a manner they think is frivolous.

"_Eighty-five percent or so of the government continues to operate, and most Americans won 't even miss it_," Rep. Good said. "_And if that 's the leverage that we need to utilize to force the Democrats to accept spending cuts and an end to the harmful policies that are, again, crushing the American people -- I mean, then we need to do that_."

For now, Speaker McCarthy is asking his party to support a short-term [continuing resolution](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGOhCAUheGnwY4JXESxoNjGbrbd0qBc9G4QjOBM5u03M_V2JznFl_w_9-nuKFJav92OtoY8uaXSAydhuJIc1ASNtwERUDVoZTeo1khjVLPZ2fWdVqKVuu_0EEIPw6x6Z3w3a-eMa8iCACWMkmLQoOEW9NzqXnofWu3ErFgr0FPN5-03U6obhvjKDzxvS96baLdaj8LUF4ORwVg33CjG98dg3PKOCZ_lM6-CDMZWdiDNwMOJ6PPOF3ctV-FHjrS8-JKTp0o5FV5qPlZ38PVtpR1T5eFKntLKZ4qRwdic1h9PipFK17NWrLujj9zU_yP9BQAA__--uGo5) that would keep the government funded while negotiation continues.
## Americans Target $1.8 Million
The average American believes they'll [need about $1.8 million](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxskD1v8yAURn8N3rDgXvyRgeFdvOVdO1rEXAIVhghIUP99lapjt0d6jnSk83HdrybEkO7_zUm6ubybo4UX7WLlKDngDoPVjggIB9JyvqBa5bri4DUiicUASCUPJXA5hJ1nYy-OFjQrwRA0CECxohSXCSYY3XRT0yKtdWoy4oZMCbKh5TJ-5pCaJxe_8ovKeORziNq39qgM_zHYGGy99_G41US9vn8G23sy2Kp5hXTnLhdeqIVCJ6XGu6fEq8_PaHngtZnS-C_pc-fn8_AMtqFo--ghxlDnhSlxP02IP_r2d43vAAAA___Ff2J7) in savings to retire well, according to a report from the Milken Institute. The report also states that the key to achieving this nest egg isn't a six-figure income or employer-matching 401k plan. Saving early rather than later is the ticket to successful retirement, and the golden age to begin saving for the golden years, the report says, is 25. In their ideal formula, an individual who saves $100 a week with a 7% rate of return will accrue roughly $1.1 million dollars by age 65. If someone waits until age 35 to employ the exact same plan, they will retire with only $300,000. "_The lack of savings vehicles for many workers is one of the most important issues that policymakers and the private sector must address_ ," [the Milken report](http://email.editor.jointheflyover.com/c/eJxs0LGuozAQheGnMV2QsXGAgoJiLa2UpEmxJTJ4BmZj7MhMEuXtr5L6tl9zjv5_5_HsKFBcLm6DnjGNbmZ6wijbg64OSo-q8D0CKNAF9NWx03Vbta0u1h4nRNO4CbGZfOvdbNDo2mgvG4my6wrqlVRatrqSnVFGlWim2jSV91gbJyctagmeOOXyf6LIK2B4pyfkck5bEfqV-b4LPQhlhbIbhRtEijsTPxjKlBeh7E4Mu1DWA7pHYKEsUvjKZ_sgW6HsYLPb4JXyDVMeZqYUr5wdw0KwY8p_4uriTHE5EQLTBpbiB1y4wvzIxG_79zKcyrvHIvf-_qIQaD82opbL5ih87_Lv9X4CAAD__xW_dMk) noted.

subject: I need to be blunt with you:
body:
This is important:
| | | | |

| | |
---
| | | _You're getting this message because you’ve supported good causes and Democratic candidates. We need your support to continue fighting for our democracy. We love having you in our network, but if you no longer wish to hear from us, you can[unsubscribe here](https://default.salsalabs.org/T0f0fd7c4-aab9-42ac-b03f-71e9de5d165d/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)._

| | | | | [](https://default.salsalabs.org/Teb648df5-2b0f-4964-9999-74034b8925b6/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Peter, During my time as president of Planned Parenthood, I watched Republicans attempt to pass horrific laws to control women's bodies. But now, with Roe v. Wade no longer the law of the land, I need to be blunt with you: Anti-choice extremists are attacking abortion access like never before. In states across this country, Republicans are doing everything in their power to restrict reproductive freedom – and Mitch McConnell and his allies have threatened to pass a national abortion ban if they take back Senate control. Political analysts say that the future of the Senate could all come down to Nevada – just like it did last year – which is why I’m reaching out today: My friend, Sen. Jacky Rosen, is running for reelection. I’m working hard to help her win this fight, and I’m asking you to join me. The GOP knows the importance of Nevada, so they’re zeroing in on Jacky as a top target for defeat. She’s facing an uphill climb and won’t be able to defend her seat without grassroots support from people like you. [So please, Peter, I’m personally asking: Will you chip in $10 – split between Jacky’s campaign and Blue Amp Action’s – to keep Nevada blue, defend the Senate, and restore reproductive freedom nationwide?](https://default.salsalabs.org/T6414611c-83d4-4bd8-86bf-a52f01f2edd8/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9)

---
| | | Last year, the GOP flooded Nevada’s Senate race with a staggering $55 million – and their handpicked candidate came within less than 8,000 votes of winning. That’s a SLIM margin. There’s no question that Jacky’s race will be just as close – and likely even more expensive. That’s why she urgently needs grassroots resources as early in the election cycle as possible. So please, Peter, can I count on you to join me in supporting Jacky today? [Donate $10 now – or however much you can spare – to keep both Nevada and the Senate blue. This race couldn’t be more pivotal in the fight to protect reproductive freedom in America.](https://default.salsalabs.org/Tf723cd7f-4fa5-4c38-b60c-21196309d056/368d17ff-e836-4168-8049-c5f0900fbbf9) Thank you, Cecile Richards

We fight for these values every day. Speaking up on our platforms, raising the voices and the political prospects of liberal pols and pundits. **And savvy grassroots activists like you know, just like we do, that we can’t stop watching the people we help elect:_ after the elections, we have to keep organizing support for the policies we like and pushing back against the ones we don’t._** **__When the public tunes out between elections and the only people our elected officials hear from are the paid lobbyists of wealthy corporations, our government stops being accountable to the needs of ordinary families.__** **Democracy never sleeps, and neither can we.** So we ask that you support our work, so we can continue to engage in this fight every moment of every day. body:
"Axe the Tax" is my plan to eliminate the individual income tax. It's a tax cut plan, not a tax replacement plan, to put more money in your pocket.

** Inside my plan to end Indiana's individual income tax and fight against Bidenflation
------------------------------------------------------------
I️ recently unveiled my plan to #AxeTheTax (https://secure.winred.com/friends-of-suzanne-crouch/hf-axe-the-tax?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=19b904da6a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_30_06_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-19b904da6a-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) by eliminating the individual income tax. I️ wrote an Op-Ed in the Indy Star (https://www.indystar.com/story/opinion/2023/08/30/indiana-income-tax-bidenflation-suzanne-crouch-governor-candidate/70707154007/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=19b904da6a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_30_06_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-19b904da6a-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) describing my plan — one that will put more money back in your pocket (where it belongs) even as Bidenflation works to empty it.
https://www.indystar.com/story/opinion/2023/08/30/indiana-income-tax-bidenflation-suzanne-crouch-governor-candidate/70707154007/?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=19b904da6a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_30_06_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-19b904da6a-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D

** Article Preview:
------------------------------------------------------------
The cost of groceries, housing, utilities and even school supplies has risen dramatically during the past few years. Families are having to choose among basic necessities.

We owe it to Hoosiers to do all we can to ease their financial burden (because help certainly isn't coming from Washington, D.C.).

The questions are simple, yet important: Who knows how best to spend and invest your money? Is it acceptable to state government to keep a $3 billion surplus? What must Indiana do to remain competitive for jobs, businesses and talent?
The answer to all these questions (and more) involves our state's tax code. Benjamin Franklin certainly had it right when he said nothing is certain except death and taxes; and while I️ can't do anything about the former, I️ can, as governor, do something about the latter.

"Axe the Tax (https://secure.winred.com/friends-of-suzanne-crouch/hf-axe-the-tax?utm_source=Suzanne+Crouch+for+Indiana&utm_campaign=19b904da6a-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_30_06_13&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-19b904da6a-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) " is my plan to eliminate Indiana's individual income tax.

Working with the General Assembly, we can keep more money in the pockets of Hoosiers, alleviate their household budget worries, implement a more efficient government, accelerate the growth of small businesses and expand Indiana's economy.

body:

Donate $27 now to help protect them and the planet from greedy interests!** _If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_ | [Donate $27 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1957709?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)

[Donate another amount](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1957712?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Montana declared war on vulnerable wolves. The wolf hunting season is now extended to _**six months**_. That means wolves are spending half of the year trying to dodge bullets from trophy hunters. Or being gunned down where they sleep. Still, brutal hunters are pushing against vital protections for wolves. All so they can keep killing them off for “fun.” **[The vicious hunt of helpless wolves can’t continue, Friend. Donate $27 today and help us reach our $4,300 to protect wolves and the planet!](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1957713?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)**
In just a few weeks, hunting season in Montana will be in full swing. Last season, hunters gunned down _**over 250 helpless wolves**_ across the state. **And this fall could be no different.** To make matters worse, Montana allows wolf hunting along Yellowstone’s northern border. That means any Yellowstone wolf that wanders over the park’s border loses its protection and is instantly fair game to hunters.
And trophy hunters don’t just kill wolves. They make them suffer using inhumane methods like neck snares and steel traps. Wolves are left reeling in pain for days before dying. And their babies are left orphaned and facing the same fate. These devastating scenes could soon become common as hunting season looms. **Unless we take action. **
**Hunting season is nearly upon us. Act now to help protect wolves and the planet: Donate $27 today!**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Donate $27 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1957709?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate $50 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1957710?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate $100 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1957711?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate another amount](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1957712?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
This fall and winter could be devastating for wolves. With **only 6,000 remaining** in the lower 48 states, these precious canines can’t afford another hunting season like this.
That’s because one wolf kill isn’t just one wolf kill. When a mama wolf is gunned down by a trophy hunter, her babies’ chances for survival plummet. Without protection, **orphaned wolf pups could starve or freeze to death.** Or they might survive long enough to fall prey to other animals and trophy hunters.
And to make matters worse, these hunting practices are worse than anything we’ve seen before. Wolves are chased down by helicopters. Run over by snowmobiles. Dynamited in their dens while they sleep. **And it’s all completely legal.**
No animal deserves this fate, Friend. But if we don’t act soon, it could get even easier for hunters to viciously torture and kill wolves in droves. That’s because Big Polluters are using their massive influence to help trophy hunters strip away the last few protections wolves still have. If they get their way, they could wipe out wolves. All so they can take over their lands and open them up for destructive mining and logging. That would also destroy any possibility of wolves being able to recover in the future.
Trophy hunters and Big Polluters have shown time and again that they care more about lining their pockets than the lives of wolves and survival of our planet. But Friend, is private profit really worth all of this bloodshed and destruction?
**Don’t let greedy corporate interests drive our last wolves to extinction. Donate $27 for wolves and the planet today!**
_If you've saved payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately:_
[Donate $27 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1957709?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate $50 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1957710?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate $100 immediately](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1957711?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
[Donate another amount](https://us.engagingnetworks.app/page/email/click/10012/1957712?email=RepJ2ZGQKX6xm5Aey7FwClESkN1MQhKC&campid=UI6tX83ZqbKZkArzVWMSmA==)
---
Here’s what we’re up against: Powerful trophy hunting and Big Oil lobbies are fighting tooth and nail against protections for wolves. Now, the U.S. Fish and Wildlife Service is ignoring science-backed wolf recovery practices. That means **struggling wolf populations are being abandoned in pro-hunting states like Montana.**
And losing wolves would have serious impacts on our planet. Wolves are a keystone species. They help balance out their ecosystems by keeping prey populations in check. Not to mention, scavengers rely on their kills to sustain them. Without wolves, other plant and animal species could suffer.
With hunting season around the corner, it’s never been more important to stand up for wolves. Friends of the Earth is working to put a stop to the violent attacks against the last surviving wolf packs and protect our planet. And that means protecting the Endangered Species Act. A vital piece of legislation, the ESA allows us to shield endangered species from violence. Even more, it gives us the power to block destructive industries like Big Oil, logging, and factory farming from destroying critical habitats for profit.
Your membership support can go a long way to fuel these efforts. But we’re up against some powerful foes. Private trophy-hunting interests and Big Polluters have seemingly bottomless resources to get their way. That’s why I’m asking for your help today. We are falling $1,293 short of our goal. But if just 1 in 12 people reading this makes a $27 membership contribution today, we can reach our $4,300 goal and make real change for wolves and the planet. Will you stand with us today?
**Stand up to greedy interests before we lose wolves forever. Donate $27 immediately to fight for wolves and the planet!**

| | Peter,

On September 30th, just about one month from today, you have an opportunity to attend one of the most important events of the year - The Global Health Freedom Summit.

We are beginning to see Big Tech, Big Pharma, and Big Government ratchet up the rhetoric around another COVID pandemic. Masking is coming back to colleges and the Biden Administration is already funding and promoting a new vaccine for the pandemic. Are you prepared? Are you educated? Do you feel equipped to handle what might be coming?

I want you to seriously consider attending this event in person or online. [Please click this link](https://drscottjensen.us8.list-manage.com/track/click?u=b954d633401c69368c934973f&id=410d2795fd&e=9828080a05) and use my coupon code: HEALTH to get 15% off your tickets.

Health freedom and parental rights are still a couple of the greatest issues we fight for today. Dr. Scott Jensen
Minnesota Family Doctor

subject: Can you handle the truth? I think you can.
disclaimer_text: Paid for by TEAM SCALISE, a joint fundraising committee authorized by and to benefit SCALISE FOR CONGRESS and EYE OF THE TIGER PAC
body:
I’d rather drink weed killer than sugarcoat the truth.

| |

---
| | | Today, I want to talk to you about the truth.

The unadorned, unvarnished truth.

The truth is important.

_Without the truth, we cannot order society.
Without the truth, we cannot survive as human beings.
Without the truth, we cannot thrive as human beings. _

_**[Can you handle the truth? I think you can.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675279%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=4XWjMoofVF4FIus0fuWSUw&sysid=1 "Can you handle the truth?
I think you can.")**_

The truth is, I think it’s important to speak your mind. So I do. Now, that makes some people mad, but I try not to worry too much about what anyone thinks of me.

I’d rather drink weed killer than sugarcoat the truth.

**So here’s the truth:** The Democrats are doing EVERYTHING in their power to destroy our country. Whether it’s leaving our borders wide open for terrorists and illicit drugs to flow through, attacking parental rights, or outrageous government spending, they will do whatever it takes to undermine the foundations of America. It all goes back to the SPECTACULARLY awful job Joe Biden has done with America.

**Here’s the solution:** We must DEFEAT the Democrats at _**every level**_ of government. This will be the only way we can stop the Democrats’ woke agenda and put America back on the path to prosperity.

**Here’s how we’ll WIN:** This all starts with YOU, Friend. I am working alongside Majority Leader Scalise to personally ask you to put your money where your mouth is and help House Republicans beat the Democrats. They were outraised last quarter by $12M, so we cannot afford for a single patriot to sideline themselves.

_**[Can I personally ask you to make a secure online contribution to this fight for the truth? I am only asking for $12 right here, right now.](https://click.americanupdate.com/Pages/Click.aspx?ghff34ghj=01%7c675270%7c210334%7c805%7cqcjvyyvf12%40tznvy.pbz&wdmdk=2%2b3LdqOiQHth4TgVmU5mCQ&sysid=1 "Can I personally ask you

### VIRGINIA BUDGET AMENDED

The Virginia legislators have reached an agreement on the "major components" of a compromise proposal that would boost education spending and offer some tax relief.
The deal includes a one-time tax rebate of $200 for individuals and $400 for joint filers. It will also increase the standard deduction, reinstate a popular sales tax holiday and allocate more revenue to public education and college financial aid.

Trish White-Boyd's race for Senate has been upgraded to a battleground race! She currently serves on the Roanoke City Council where she helped bring jobs and grow businesses, delivered library and parks restorations, and implemented measures to cut crime.
Trish has lived in our district for over 40 years, and she and her husband have raised their family here. Trish started and operates a successful home health care company and currently employs dozens of people in the area.
Our part of Virginia has been brushed aside by both political parties for far too long. Trish is running for Senate to advance the interests of this district, and she will work with Republicans or Democrats to restore prosperity in SWVA.

Updates from Peter Hernandez for Congress | | | [View this email in your browser](https://mailchi.mp/c4f6d50adc3f/looking-forward-to-9161376?e=638e6c2751)

| | [ ](https://hernandezforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=314f047675baff18221b82bdc&id=3c9f39bb1b&e=638e6c2751)
---
| | | **WE THE PEOPLE V. WOKE SCHOOLS**
The Bill of Rights from its inception set a clear barrier around the people and their rights. This boundary was not created just for the time of our country's inception, but to ensure it stood in perpetuity. Bill of Rights case-in-point today: the parents rights movement. We have parents intent on protecting their children, and local school boards following through with cementing those rights in their policies, but then California state Attorney General Rob Bonta attacking those parents by suing their school board - you officially have a Constitutional crisis.
[READ THIS ARTICLE ABOUT THE UPHEAVAL IN CHINO HILLS ](https://hernandezforcongress.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=314f047675baff18221b82bdc&id=dc3b642583&e=638e6c2751)
As we’ve always known, the most impactful and best government is local. I've argued from the beginning that local control is essential to representation, and a healthy community. But our out-of-control administrative state is daily erasing our Bill of Rights barrier. I'm hungry to educate people on the Constitutional separation of powers, and strengthen the clear defensive line between governments and its citizens. I’m ready to support policies that strip government of funding if they intend to use their heavy hand over its citizens. Now more than ever there needs to be a wider separation between powers exercised by government.

In Liberty,
Peter Hernandez

We have followed closely the situation in Spreckels Union School District in Monterey County. The district has gotten out of admitting to wrongdoing in this settlement, but at least it's setting a bit of a precedent for further cases.

I’m running for my daughter, my son, and our future generations. I want them to experience the freedom and opportunity that the American Dream has to offer. When you’re a child, your mind is soaking up everything, Peter.

You’re growing, learning, understanding, and slowly but surely, evolving into the person you eventually become.

You’ve probably heard me talk about my great-grandmother Maebell James, but ever since I was little, she taught me that it’s our responsibility to help others, even when it isn’t easy.

If you don’t like something, she’d say, “Go farther and do better.” That message has been my north star during my time in public service and this campaign for the U.S. Senate here in Maryland.

**Together, we’re going to go farther and do better so that future generations have safe communities, a healthy and habitable planet, and a system that benefits working families.**

So even though I’m sharing a throwback with you, I want to be clear that my message in this race is about moving Maryland _forward._

| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! Rudy Giuliani speaks to the media after leaving the Fulton County Jail: Aug. 23, 2023 in Atlanta, Georgia. Giuliani is one of 19, including former President Donald Trump, facing felony charges in the indictment related to alleged tampering of the 2020 election in Georgia. (Source: Joe Raedle/Getty Images/Newsmax)

By Scott Kaspar

On Aug. 23, former New York City mayor Rudy Giuliani surrendered (https://www.newsmax.com/politics/rudy-giuliani-2020-election-charges/2023/08/23/id/1131780/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=65ec0c31fa-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_31_01_14&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-65ec0c31fa-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) to authorities at the Fulton County Jail in Atlanta, Georgia.

His alleged crime? Representing his client, former President Donald Trump.

Did lawyers across the country immediately come to his defense to express outrage over the indictment?

No.

Did the American Bar Association put out a statement about the chilling effect an indictment like this will have on lawyers’ ethical obligations to be zealous advocates?

No.

Did President Biden, a former lawyer who taught constitutional law at Widener University for nearly two decades, condemn the indictment?

No.

Pundits on CNN (https://www.cnn.com/videos/politics/2023/08/23/rudy-giuliani-plane-arrives-georgia-vpx.cnn?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=65ec0c31fa-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_31_01_14&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-65ec0c31fa-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) did express outrage, but not about the indictment.

They filled an entire segment of live television breathlessly talking about the private jet (https://www.illinoisreview.com/illinoisreview/2023/08/breaking-records-over-200-million-people-tuned-into-tuckers-interview-with-trump-as-vivek-dominated-desantis-on-gop-primary-debate-stage-and-trump-makes-ratings-history.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=65ec0c31fa-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_31_01_14&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-65ec0c31fa-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) that brought Giuliani to his arraignment, but not one word about the alleged crimes underlying that arraignment.

What about Republicans?

What did they have to say about Giuliani’s indictment?

Just hours after Giuliani’s indictment, the RNC and Fox News hosted the first Republican presidential debate. Did Giuliani’s indictment come up at all over the course of the entire debate?

No. Not word one.

Giuliani’s own words spoken that day during an interview with Newsmax (https://www.newsmax.com/newsmax-tv/rudy-giuliani-indictment-georgia/2023/08/23/id/1131806/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=65ec0c31fa-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_31_01_14&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-65ec0c31fa-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) capture the reason why every lawyer in America should be outraged:

"They operate like communists . . . this was a terrible thing. And it’s not because of me . . . look at all the attorneys that are being prosecuted here.

"I’m basically being prosecuted for doing what I’ve done . . . over and over again as part of my profession. And in my case, I believe I was defending and advocating for an innocent man."

There is a constitutional right to counsel in criminal cases.

The Sixth Amendment guarantees it. And that guarantee does not waiver if the defendant is a controversial figure like President Trump. If the Sixth Amendment says that President Trump has a right to counsel, then his lawyer — Rudy Giuliani — has a right to carry out that job without the fear of later being indicted for doing that job.

There also is a constitutional right to petition the government. And it’s not buried in the Constitution – no, it’s right there in the First Amendment:

"Congress shall make no law respecting an establishment of religion, or prohibiting the free exercise thereof; or abridging the freedom of speech, or of the press; or the right of the people peaceably to assemble, and to petition the Government for a redress of grievances."

Whether President Trump’s claims of voter fraud in Fulton County are true or not does not matter, President Trump had a constitutional right to challenge the election.

And Rudy Giuliani used the procedures — demanding recounts and lobbying state legislatures—that lawyers typically use when challenging election results.

Indicting lawyers for doing their job not only flies in the face of the First and Sixth Amendments, but it will have a chilling effect on lawyers’ eagerness to take on clients who are not aligned with the current party in power.

Thankfully, not all lawyers have been silent.

Famed lawyer and former Harvard professor Alan Dershowitz said that what Giuliani did following the 2020 election is no different than what he and other lawyers did on behalf of Al Gore in 2000.

According to Dershowitz (https://rumble.com/v388hlb-how-i-would-defend-trump-and-his-codefendants-against-flawed-rico-prosecuti.html?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=65ec0c31fa-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_31_01_14&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-65ec0c31fa-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) , the indictment against Giuliani could be applied against him for his work in the U.S. Supreme Court case of Bush v. Gore, 531 U.S. 98 (2000).

"According to the indictments, these are now crimes," Dershowitz said.

Attorney and former U.S. Sen. Alfonse D’Amato, R-N.Y., spoke out on Newsmax (https://www.newsmax.com/newsmax-tv/alfonse-damato-newsmax-rudy-giuliani/2023/08/24/id/1131963/?utm_source=Illinois+Review&utm_campaign=65ec0c31fa-EMAIL_CAMPAIGN_2023_08_31_01_14&utm_medium=email&utm_term=0_-65ec0c31fa-%5BLIST_EMAIL_ID%5D) :

"Rudy Giuliani and I are not particularly close. He was a great mayor and was a great U.S. attorney. We have our differences. But I’ll tell you, this is wrong, and it threatens America’s democracy."

D’Amato clarified:

"This is not law enforcement. This is terrorizing the opposition, and that’s what’s going on.

"You arrest or charge a lawyer because he is representing someone who believes the election was stolen? No.

"The election may or may not have been stolen but you don’t go after and then indict the lawyer.

"That is absolutely BS."

If the indictment against Rudy Giuliani is not faced as a great American injustice, it will be repeated. And it will destroy the American system of justice.

Scott Kaspar is a lawyer licensed in Illinois, Iowa, Colorado, and California, and before the U.S. Patent and Trademark Office. He regularly appears on media to provide legal analysis. Kaspar also is the Publisher of Illinois Review, the largest conservative news source in Illinois.

| Friends,
We are looking forward to a wonderful Labor Day weekend with family and friends. It has been fun meeting and listening to folks like you while campaigning around the district. As Governor Glenn Youngkin says, we "must lock arms" and win in November. Because, right now, that is all that matters!
As you know, the General Assembly still has not passed the update to the budget where we hope to give Virginia Tax Payers another one billion dollars in tax relief, support education, law enforcement, veterans, and more. Hopefully the Democrats will support these efforts to help the folks. So, we are going into session next Wednesday September 6 to hopefully finalize the budget.
FYI, the all new General Assembly building is open to the public October 11. I'm looking forward working and representing you as your next State Senator of District 10 there soon!
---
| Louisa County 11 Billion Dollar Project
---
|
---
| For over a year now, on the campaign trail, Louisa County residents pointed out to us a need to lower the real estate tax rate in Louisa County to even out the huge cost of living increase in Louisa caused by the over 40% increase in real estate tax assessments. It was explained, this is especially important for folks living on a fixed income. The announcement of the Amazon Web Service's (AWS) 11 billion dollar Data Center investment in Louisa County comes from what appears to be an opportunity to create jobs and increase the Louisa County tax revenues without adding new subdivisions, roof tops, increased pressure on K-12, and other revenue consumers. We hear about the negative effects to families caused by the ever increasing cost of living at just about every door we knock. It is my hope that the real estate taxes paid by AWS will encourage the Louisa County Board of Supervisors to lower taxes and and give the folks some relief.
---

| | In politics, like in football, we think in four quarters. Our four quarters are divided by the fiscal calendar, and each quarter, the FEC requires us to release our fundraising numbers, giving our supporters (and our opponents) insight into where we’re at.

We’re about to head into the fourth quarter, _**but we’re currently DOWN.**_

We’ve seen incredible comebacks before. Our victories in 2020 and 2021 are notable examples of times that people counted us out – where the national pundits thought we had no chance at victory, but we beat the odds, defeating Donald Trump and flipping control of the Senate.

Right now, we’re down. We’re behind on fundraising. Donald Trump’s poll numbers are as strong as ever. _**And we’re running out of time.**_

So I’m coming to you with a request: [**__Pitch in. Whatever you can afford, pitch in.__**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68981113/424709663/710125701?refcode=20230831.1_JP_8AT&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NmNhZjNmYy0wNjQ4LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=z2RstLbRW3ZYEKvgJbawcdrjSgsoqVm9U_QKDYMA7YE=)

If we enter the fourth quarter down, then we’re going to have to triple – quadruple our efforts. If we enter the fourth quarter strong, then we’ll need to keep that pace up, but we won’t have to play catch up.

[**_Please, we need as many supporters as possible to pitch in before our end of month deadline tonight at midnight._**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68981114/424709664/710125701?refcode=20230831.1_JP_8AT&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTAvMS83OTA4MSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI5NmNhZjNmYy0wNjQ4LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=z2RstLbRW3ZYEKvgJbawcdrjSgsoqVm9U_QKDYMA7YE=)

Thank you for your support, and together, we will beat the odds _AGAIN_ and keep Georgia blue in 2024.

– Justin

_Because of the support we receive from hundreds of thousands of members across the country,_ Judicial Watch is America's indispensable, independent watchdog in Washington.

_Because of our members’ support,_ we are leading the legal charge to uncover massive Biden family corruption...

_Because of our members’ support,_ we have _successfully settled_ voter-roll related lawsuits with **Colorado** , **Illinois** and **Pennsylvania** this year, and our lawyers are now researching electoral data to determine if additional states need to be "warned" by us about their failure to clean their voter rolls...

_Because of our members’ support_ , we are have exposed the widespread weaponization of federal agencies and the misuse of prosecutorial power by the Biden administration targeting conservatives and other political opponents...

...while every day we are also doing the vital work of using the legal system and the courts to force the release of public documents that "we the people" have a right to see!

**_In short, thanks to our members we are fighting doggedly and persistently for the rule of law and for accountability in government_****!**

Bill grew up in Baton Rouge, Louisiana, and is a proud LSU graduate. He worked in Louisiana’s charity hospital system for over 25 years, ensuring that the less fortunate in our state were able to receive quality health care. Later, Bill co-founded the Greater Baton Rouge Community Clinic, providing free dental and health care to working families without insurance. In the wake of Hurricane Katrina, Bill led a group of volunteers to convert an abandoned K-Mart building into an emergency healthcare facility.
As a conservative in the Senate, he focuses on the issues Louisiana families care about the most. Bill is working to lower the cost of health care, make flood insurance affordable, and save Social Security from a 24% cut if Washington fails to act.
Bill, and his wife, Laura, live in Baton Rouge and attend church at the Chapel on the Campus. They are blessed with three children and one grandchild.

body:
I’m in a tough race here in Pennsylvania, and every dollar makes a difference.
# [](https://go.bobcasey.com/go/181?t=1&akid=534%2E552475%2EuEIptS)
Hi Peter, I'm writing to ask if you will make a $5 contribution to our campaign today.
**[I want to take a minute to explain why this request matters to our campaign, but if you are ready to help us hold Pennsylvania you can chip in at this link now. I'm grateful for your support.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230831-1?refcode=em20230831-1&refcode2=534_552475_uEIptS&akid=534%2E552475%2EuEIptS)**

$5 may not sound like much. It's about the price of a water ice, a Hershey bar, or half of a cheesesteak. But the truth is, when enough folks chip in a few dollars whenever they can -- whether it's $50, $25, or even $5 -- it makes a difference.
And the stakes of this race are high.
I'm #4 on Mitch McConnell's list of races he's targeting, and news outlets like CNN and Roll Call are calling PA a top Senate battleground. All eyes will be on our race as we head into 2024, which is why we have to build a strong campaign now.
I know we have what it takes to fight back against whatever the GOP throws at us. We made history by electing Josh Shapiro and John Fetterman in 2022, and we're going to need that same momentum on our side to win in 2024.
**[So if you're able, will you chip in $5 to my re-election campaign? I'm in a tough race here in Pennsylvania, and every dollar makes a difference.](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/casey-em-20230831-1?refcode=em20230831-1&refcode2=534_552475_uEIptS&akid=534%2E552475%2EuEIptS)**

We are building a campaign of supporters across Pennsylvania and the country, and I'm proud to have you on our team.
With gratitude,
Bob

Hi Peter,

If you watched the debate, you know why I'm running for president and the solutions I have to offer to get our country back on track.

But, whether you've been with me from the start or this is the first time you're hearing about me, I couldn't be more grateful to have you on board.

With the first debate kicking this election into high gear, I think it's important to take a few minutes to introduce myself and talk about the journey I have been on. **[Once you've finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=0ac680ccf3eb4853a66e2c608ae63fb0&_e=dIeCbt37-QrHUkfR412n3VPIR36A9NNeeYBzk8LszX7tWU696y-W20ofzmcdidz-K66-4s7MsgFstXG5zPhu8wHfQSEKIEs_zpAxZNym8DZpn-ryi73oo_O1P1vrUSniE3yYR4dGdL0uUaMzc7kONlv0S-VlqpN1YPpuxL7GgO82AvfO2L-A0tXzuizhWowcez15SMomHMR31fRTxHOqQt8toDkd-sW6HPvbTTpG5d_eNzX0o7IMA2sOuQrGFCK-J0NOMNAwU_cib-xPotBCvm7Fa1fqFWIukgyeJjUpBhnG5yjAKEK6hYe4xIwYfb_GOTShuH1S6NBuRVBtXUyykRZaMQ-JTUkMUP--njO1GX-Iokj3u5p6-qtgSE4KxiBx "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!")**

Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. _**Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words.**_
| | | | | [](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=0ac680ccf3eb4853a66e2c608ae63fb0&_e=dIeCbt37-QrHUkfR412n3VPIR36A9NNeeYBzk8LszX7tWU696y-W20ofzmcdidz-K66-4s7MsgFstXG5zPhu8wHfQSEKIEs_zpAxZNym8DZpn-ryi73oo_O1P1vrUSniE3yYR4dGdL0uUaMzc7kONlv0S-VlqpN1YPpuxL7GgO82AvfO2L-A0tXzuizhWowcez15SMomHMR31fRTxHOqQt8toDkd-sW6HPvbTTpG5d9eYnOED4wsBCwkG1bS4goTXgQxzB9opmlYCtW2kYGR81XV7iTfDl513IfdrHOrBtUrnQU8EsF8zmYxCBjrlcs7I2J8JjhigfRiSdkmaoqUdyryyzHfUvEUnrdMoRKkNW1bfgNfpON_dTEg5ph6Ity0)
---
| I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it.
---

After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: _" Don't complain. Do something about it." _

---
| | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. **But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won.**
---
| | [](http://links.freedomtrainalert.com/u/click?_t=2d4f229f156142619b4e4f956d2d65c9&_m=0ac680ccf3eb4853a66e2c608ae63fb0&_e=dIeCbt37-QrHUkfR412n3VPIR36A9NNeeYBzk8LszX7tWU696y-W20ofzmcdidz-K66-4s7MsgFstXG5zPhu8wHfQSEKIEs_zpAxZNym8DZpn-ryi73oo_O1P1vrUSniE3yYR4dGdL0uUaMzc7kONlv0S-VlqpN1YPpuxL7GgO82AvfO2L-A0tXzuizhWowcez15SMomHMR31fRTxHOqQt8toDkd-sW6HPvbTTpG5d9_ADhiOssId4cjKUjDoVxuuhgacB106mdyZqha99KoKJXen2tZSX_pmh7iLnKRlgKmrOxOIFZNufbOHKBjEG966a3qF5IGJY0MbgXmHxCOPBCe-VuA3vOe_70-nyYgdAXRshsuY1fFReMGJI3i1DNQ)

It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor.

When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy.

When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! The dictators, murderers, and thieves at the UN didn't know what hit them.

But, whether you've been with me from the start or this is the first time you're hearing about me, I couldn't be more grateful to have you on board. With the first debate kicking this election into high gear, I think it's important to take a few minutes to introduce myself and talk about the journey I have been on. "Once youâ€TMve finished reading this, please consider making a contribution of any amount to help me keep my campaign momentum STRONG!" Ever since I launched my campaign for President, I have read and heard my life described in every way imaginable. Today, I want you to hear my story in MY words. | | | | | | I am the daughter of legal immigrants from a small, rural town in South Carolina. We were the only Indian family in our town. My father wore a turban as he still does to this day, and my mother wore a sari. No one knew who we were, what we were, or why we were there. But with each passing day, the community began to look beyond our skin color. They began to see my family for who we are: hard working people who held the same values they cherished. Gradually, those initial stares transformed into smiles and we shifted from being excluded to embraced. Not every day was perfect. But every day was better than the one before it. After graduating from Clemson and working in the corporate world, I decided to take a job working for my family's business that my mother started in our living room when I was a child. I was frustrated when I saw how hard it was to make a dollar and how easy it was for government to take it away. When I voiced these frustrations to my mom, she gave me some wise advice which was: " Don't complain. Do something about it." | | | So, that's exactly what I did and I decided to run for state legislature. But it wasn't easy. I ran against the longest-serving legislator in the state and no one believed I had a chance. I was polling at a mere 15 percent a week before the primary. But the people of South Carolina took a chance on me, and we won. | | It was an honor to serve the people as a state legislator. I fought against the status quo and stood up for the people of my district. When I fought for government transparency by pushing to make sure important votes were on the record, my colleagues retaliated. They stripped me of my committees. So I decided to run for governor. When I campaigned for governor, people didn't know who I was. I was polling in fourth place, with limited time until Election Day. I was the least funded and least known GOP candidate. But together, we defied expectations and won. Then, we made a difference in South Carolina by cutting taxes, creating thousands of jobs, and revitalizing our economy. When I was nominated as Ambassador to the United Nations, people said I didn't have the experience. I proved them wrong. When I got to the UN, I took the "kick-me" sign off our back. I told the world that America would have the backs of our allies, and for those who did not have our backs, we were taking names! Team,

In a moment, I'm going to ask you to consider **[chipping in $10, or whatever you can, to help me reach the $25,000 end-of-month fundraising goal this campaign has set.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68986856/424730587/688272239?refcode=em23_230831_eom2_fndd_gq_act___DKFC_ettx&utm_campaign=em23_230831_eom2_fndd_gq_act___DKFC_ettx&utm_medium=email&refcode2=fd36a511-0f48-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&amounts=5,10,25,50,100&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQNTAvMS8xMDMzNzUiLA0KICAiRGlzdHJpYnV0aW9uVW5pcXVlSWQiOiAiZmQzNmE1MTEtMGY0OC1lZTExLWEzZjEtMDAyMjQ4MzJlYjczIiwNCiAgIkVtYWlsQWRkcmVzcyI6ICJkcHdpbGxpczY3QGdtYWlsLmNvbSINCn0%3D&hmac=zZTuJgKL0tCVicVZ6cViBYOjPRLZMA5fV4ucnJwUUc0=)** **But first, let me tell you a bit about what we're fighting for and what we've achieved so far:**

When I look back at my time in Congress as your representative, I am overwhelmed with pride and can't help but reflect on all we've accomplished — _together_ — for our district and state.

From my beginnings in economic development to my service in the Washington State Capitol, and now as your representative in the U.S. House, it has been an honor to stand up for the people of our region. **I could not be more proud to dedicate my career to folks from every corner of our beautiful state.**

With you by my side every step of the way, we're shaping a brighter future and making real progress on Capitol Hill. Just this year, we've launched the Puget Sound Federal Leadership Task Force, a collaboration with Rep. Marilyn Strickland, to enhance our region's influence on critical federal issues.

We've: introduced the Mental Health Improvement Act to tackle the mental health crisis within our armed forces; proposed the Yes In My Backyard Act, a crucial step toward investing in affordable, safe housing for our communities; secured _crucial_ funding for our region to improve salmon populations and protect our natural resources...**and SO much more.**

But let me be clear: _Our work is far from over._ From fighting to protect and advance fundamental voting rights to working to enshrine a woman's right to reproductive freedom into federal law since the fall of _Roe v. Wade_ , it's evident that the road ahead won't be without its challenges. But as long as I can count on your support, I know we have what it takes to not only protect this seat — but also to create real change for folks all across Washington.

As we look ahead to the 2024 election, I'm more determined than ever to roll up my sleeves and build a winning campaign powered by individuals like you who believe in our mission. [**That's why I'm reaching out today to ask for your support: My campaign has set an ambitious end-of-month fundraising goal of $25,000 for August, and I'm hopeful our incredible team will once again come through to help us reach it. body:
Rhode Island’s special election is next week.
#
Aaron Regunberg is a progressive running for Congress in Rhode Island, and he needs our help.
Aaron started as a community organizer, founding an organization that supports young people fighting for better public schools. He then served in the Rhode Island General Assembly, where he raised wages for the first time in 20 years, established online voter registration, and expanded access to renewable energy. As a climate lawyer, Aaron helped develop litigation to hold Big Oil companies accountable for environmental crimes.
Now, he’s running for Congress to break up monopolies, protect queer and trans folks, defend Social Security and Medicare, and ban assault weapons.
**But with less than a week left until Rhode Island’s special election, Aaron’s moderate primary challengers are gaining on him.**
[Aaron stands with Alexandria for working families, and is ready to take on BIg Pharma, Big Oil, and Big Banks. Will you make a $5 contribution to our campaigns today and help grow our movement for a better future in Congress?](https://act.ocasiocortez.com/go/14659?c0=aoc-email-20230831-1.P6g-MZ&refcode=em20230831-4907-P_FND_EGR_GFM&amounts=5%2C20%2C50%2C100%2C250%2C500%2C1000&t=1&akid=4907%2E2526796%2ECjz6Mw)

subject: New Episode Alert! Hear from Legendary News Anchor Dick Knipfing
body:
🎙️ Stream the latest No Doubt About It Podcast | | | | | |
---
[](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=688ca285c6&e=567664f14c)
Friend, we’re excited for a [**brand new episode**](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=d8730a907c&e=567664f14c) of the podcast, with legendary anchor Dick Knipfing!

➡ [**STREAM EPISODE NOW**](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=935f92dee7&e=567664f14c)
In this episode, we had the incredible honor of sitting down with a true titan in the world of New Mexico news. **For an impressive 51 years, Dick brought unbiased news to the people of New Mexico** , becoming a trusted voice in their lives.
Many of you might remember that Mark was the Chief Meteorologist and Dick was the main anchor at KRQE-TV, a partnership that led the channel to **dominate New Mexico's airwaves for a decade**!
| | | | | | | | | [](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=c39f1ab074&e=567664f14c)
---
# WATCH EPISODE 32:
We dive into some riveting behind-the-scenes stories from our time together, reminiscing about the remarkable journey we shared at KRQE-TV.

Moreover, we tackle the pressing social issues Albuquerque is grappling with, including the challenging topics of homelessness and escalating violent crime. Dick offers insightful perspectives on these issues, drawing from his extensive experience in reporting and understanding the pulse of the city.
| [WATCH EPISODE 32](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=3de9ae17e4&e=567664f14c)
---
As the conversation unfolds, we also explore Dick's Catholic faith and his staunch pro-life beliefs, giving you an intimate glimpse into the personal side of this legendary news anchor.
| [WATCH EPISODE 32](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=d42a5cdae1&e=567664f14c)
---

| | | | | | | | | [](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=387f9d6517&e=567664f14c)

We invite you to join us on this enlightening journey by tuning in to the latest episode on your [preferred podcast platform](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=5f644521fa&e=567664f14c). Whether it's Apple Podcasts, Spotify, Google Podcasts, or any other platform, your support means the world to us. Don't forget to hit that **'Like'** , **'Listen'** , and **'Subscribe'** button to ensure you never miss an episode!

|

Subscribe to our [**YouTube channel**](https://nodoubtaboutitpodcast.us18.list-manage.com/track/click?u=d2649c77b4f4f1f9d512804d2&id=fdc774f9a7&e=567664f14c) for video versions of our podcast episodes, allowing you to experience the conversations in a whole new way.
