body:
Here’s something that D.C. elitists just don’t understand... | | | | | | | | |
---
Friend, I’ve been proud to wear boots my whole life. I wore combat boots during my time serving in Afghanistan Then, after I was caught in a roadside bomb explosion, my days of wearing combat boots were over. But I didn’t let that stop me. I traded them for a pair of work boots and got to work in a packaging warehouse to provide for my family. Now, these boots are working harder than ever as my wife and I raise our three children and travel across the rugged landscape of Nevada talking with everyday voters. **[If you ask me, Washington needs a lot more boots, and a lot less suits.](https://americanvictory2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0631e376515e4dcd945c8fba9&id=fe002a0ec3&e=84ee529f47)** Out-of-touch, elitist politicians who have never put in a hard day’s work in their lives are making decisions that impact everyday Americans like you and me. They don’t understand what we go through. They don’t keep our best interests in mind. _Heck, most of them have probably never even owned a pair of boots in their lives._ If you think it’s long past time that people who wear boots, not people who wear suits, have a say in how things are run around here, **[I’d be honored to have your support.](https://americanvictory2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0631e376515e4dcd945c8fba9&id=28b1d4fdb0&e=84ee529f47)**
---
[**Help the Boots Win: CHIP IN NOW**](https://americanvictory2024.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=0631e376515e4dcd945c8fba9&id=814309e6ad&e=84ee529f47)
---
Elitists in Washington don’t understand people like us, and probably never will. It’s time that we take back control and build an America that works for all of us. Can I count on you to help me out? Duty First, Sam

#
[**I am respectfully asking you to contribute $3 before the Long Run’s August end-of-month fundraising deadline at midnight tonight.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-aug23.iWpG7e&refcode=em230831-1-t3&t=1&akid=4786%2E196590%2EoZVgPQ)
Here's why:
After last week’s Republican Debate in Milwaukee, it's clearer than ever that Democrats are at risk in 2024, in every manner. We are facing Trump’s, Ron Desantis’, and even Ramaswamy’s mega-donor funded presidential campaigns, and we hold a slim Democratic Senate majority that Republicans are already coming after.
So it is no exaggeration that Democrats are vulnerable in 2024 — and truthfully, so is our democracy.
But we have the power to make a difference in 2024 — in races across the country, up and down the ballot. And I’m proud to say we have already done so in Wisconsin’s Supreme Court race and Virginia’s State Senate race.
But we can’t stop there. There is much more work to be done, and as we inch closer to 2024, I am going to need your unwavering support to continue supporting changemaking candidates across the country.
Friend, I simply cannot fight this fight alone.
So I'm relying on folks like you who have helped us build a true grassroots movement to continue supporting candidates in critical races across the country — all the way from Colin Allred’s race to unseat Ted Cruz in Texas to Tammy Baldwin’s reelection campaign in Wisconsin.
[**So can I count on you to contribute $3 ahead of our August end-of-month fundraising deadline? It would mean a lot if you could chip in today.**](https://act.mandelabarnes.com/go/1212?c0=longrunpac-em-aug23.iWpG7e&refcode=em230831-1-t3&t=2&akid=4786%2E196590%2EoZVgPQ)

name: Katie Porter
subject: Do you think our current system is good enough?
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Katie Porter for Senate
body:
# [](https://act.katieporter.com/go/14558?t=1&akid=29092%2E3422442%2E-7aHgD)
As we near the end of another month (and another fundraising deadline), I wanted to take a moment and reflect on why I decided to run for Senate in the first place:
Because “better than the way things were” _isn’t good enough._
_It’s not “good enough” that huge corporations are making record profits while more and more families can’t afford necessities._
_It’s not “good enough” that my kids have to ask if they are safe at school after they hear about shooting after shooting._
_It’s not “good enough” that extremist politicians could ban abortion nationwide if they win just a few more Senate seats._
**Our country isn’t working for the majority of working people.** Republicans funded by big corporate interests have rigged the game against families, making it difficult to get ahead. The elected leaders we send to Washington must be accountable to the people they represent, and they must prove to voters that democracy can work for them.
**That’s why I’m running for the Senate, and I want you on my team.[Can you make a donation to help us meet our August fundraising goal so I can fight for families like yours and mine?](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230831-1?amount=5&refcode=EMAK31_1_EOM_20230831_V1_F&refcode2=29092_3422442_-7aHgD&akid=29092%2E3422442%2E-7aHgD)**
[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230831-1?amount=5&refcode=EMAK31_1_EOM_20230831_V1_F&refcode2=29092_3422442_-7aHgD&akid=29092%2E3422442%2E-7aHgD)
I’ve spent my career—both before and after being elected to the House—delivering for working people and protecting taxpayers.
**In the House, I was the only Democrat to oppose “earmarks,” which are a way to fund Members' pet projects.** I’m leading the fight to ban congressional stock trading, and the whiteboard you may have seen me bring to hearings is more than a fun prop—my questioning of witnesses in congressional hearings **secured free COVID testing for every American, helped us pass bills that lower costs for families, and showed how corporate profits drove inflation.**
Before I ran for office, I was a consumer protection advocate, and I worked directly with California families who were cheated by the five biggest Wall Street banks prior to the 2008 mortgage crisis. **I held the banks’ feet to the fire and won thousands of victories against the banks, forcing them to pay California families billions.**
I wouldn’t be running if I didn’t know we have what it takes to win, and more importantly, to serve the people of California. But as Elizabeth Warren taught me, _nobody wins alone._ **This will be a competitive and expensive race, and I’d be so honored to have your support.**
[**Can you make your first contribution before our fundraising deadline at midnight to help send this single working mom to the U.S. Senate, so I can be a warrior for working people and families like yours and mine?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-20230831-1?amount=5&refcode=EMAK31_1_EOM_20230831_V1_F&refcode2=29092_3422442_-7aHgD&akid=29092%2E3422442%2E-7aHgD)
Thank you for your support,
Katie Porter

Katie is running for the U.S. Senate because Californians deserve a warrior fighting for them in Washington. Our campaign is people-powered, we don’t take a dime from corporate PACs, federal lobbyists, or executives from Big Oil or Big Pharma. **[Donate ›››](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/kp4s-em-footer?refcode=EMAK31_1_EOM_20230831_V1_F&t=2&refcode2=29092_3422442_-7aHgD&akid=29092%2E3422442%2E-7aHgD)**

Hola Peter,
I’m Democrat Raquel Terán and in April, I announced that I was running to represent Arizona’s 3rd District in Congress – and what a journey it has been since then.
I started working in our community nearly two decades ago as an organizer for Mi Familia Vota, working to get border communities and Latinos out to vote. Later on I served in both the Arizona State House and the State Senate fighting for immigrants, women and working families.
My belief in democracy, equality, fairness and family is as strong, if not stronger, now then it was when I first started. Now I’m ready to take the fight to the Congress.
Or should I say WE are going to take the fight to Congress. Because this campaign isn’t about me. This campaign, like the ones we’ve run before, will be about centering our communities and building as big a coalition as we can. It’s how we’ve won before, and how I know we will do it again in 2024.
We’ve already got some amazing working class champions on our team like Senator Mark Kelly, LUCHA, the Working Families Party and former Congresswoman Ann Kirkpatrick.
With a challenging primary ahead of us and a long way before the general election, our grassroots campaign is in it for the long haul – and we’ll need you onboard.
So, Peter, can you join our grassroots campaign? Contribute today >> [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/upliftteran?refcode=X_updatedwelcomeseries&amount=25]
Sí se puede,
Raquel Terán

subject: Fight for parental rights
body:
Peter, URGENT! If you're as disgusted as we are about the assault happening on moms and dads in New Jersey, YOU CAN HELP STOP
|
---
| Peter, **URGENT! If you're as disgusted as we are about the assault happening on moms and dads in New Jersey,_YOU CAN HELP STOP IT!_** You've probably heard about the extreme, illogical, anti-reality and unethical amendments to school “equity” requirements passed by the State Board of Education on August 2, 2023. The radical changes being forced on Jersey school kids and teachers are an attempt to erase the terms “male” and “female.” **The state’s lawyers actually argued in Court, and won, that it is illegal in NJ for schools to notify parents if their child wants to change their gender identity, including changes in pronouns, name, bathroom preferences, and participation in sports teams. It’s time to fight back against the insanity of ‘transing’ kids. The reality is there is no such thing as a ‘trans kid’. There are kids who may suffer from gender dysphoria, kids who suffer from anxiety and depression that can lead to them acting out. And sadly, many confused and misguided kids will fall for the cruel deception that they were “born in the wrong body”. It’s time to stop the trans cult from grooming and permanently damaging our kids. It’s time that NJ laws and government reflect the values of our people. Parent's rights are paramount to raising and protecting kids. Period.**
Heard enough? **You can help REPEAL this egregious amendment.
** **[Click here](https://xtz223.keap-link016.com/v2/click/145523bcc6d94bebdabca2cd48913c87/eJyNkFtvgkAQhf_LPqNcpKYhaRpCkFAEDULFvjQUFrsIuxt28Br-u2vb-NQmfZyZb86cMxcEmOYU_BJZ6Ahnw5ggBXW4IJxgCg6jkBdfU-PB1Ce6ghpCd17Heo6sy6_Ld-DW1k3jUUFw4lgiSWw7gR9573M_CiTJ807e-J-Obpp3HTe0_Tkahj-FcUvA3UttgSzoenxLVBKZCtKukfwnABeWqlasa8WYVRUp8LhgrbrMt1ioMRacUYFv1TgX_PhMyieXRsvVgZbrtDXeYD39KGoNotE6E0ldJI3dxKOZPt1vTlmcLtzwENYv2arZ6qnLDtGu9MLz62almVo64-HCMXtpM-cc0_LnxwE-fZsdrkXfhW0=) **to submit a petition for rulemaking to the Department of Education. You can also submit a petition to the Office of the State Board of Education by [**clicking here to write a quick email.**](mailto:statebd@doe.nj.gov) **The Code is: N.J.A.C. 6A:7. You want them to REPEAL.** Give reasons, like the following:
Unconstitutional
Anti-Science
Violates Religious Freedoms
Harms Children
Government overreach
Harms teachers **_The government's job is to protect our rights, not trample them._** **This isn’t about science – it's about radical politics.** You and I know that there are two genders: male and female. And you cannot be born in the ‘wrong body’. That defies logic, reason and biology. If we're going to teach our kids something, let’s base it on facts, not on the extreme agenda of radicals committed to destroying our communities, our families and our nation.
Innocent boys and girls, too young to decide on what to eat or when to go to bed, can now be pushed down a path that can lead to mutilation surgery, drugs, suicide or a lifetime of mental health problems. All hidden legally by NJ bureaucrats. _**Our rights as parents are being stripped away by radicals and the morally bankrupt judges who back up insane policies like this.**_

name: Ro Khanna
subject: Tell Congress: Americans need quality, affordable childcare
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Ro for Congress
body:
https://rokhanna.com [https://rokhanna.com]

Friend,

Working families are standing on the edge of a cliff.

Congress secured the child care industry during and after the pandemic with a $24 billion investment as part of the American Rescue Plan Act in 2021. Now that funding is expected to expire tomorrow. The ramifications of this change are disastrous; According to the Robert Wood Johnson Foundation, it’s estimated that over 3 million children could lose access to care, particularly those from underserved communities. Meanwhile, over 200,000 child care providers could lose their jobs and over 70,000 child care facilities would be at risk of closing.

With childcare costs outpacing inflation [https://www.cnbc.com/2022/02/21/average-cost-of-child-care-is-now-more-than-10000-dollars-per-year.html] and millions of working families paying an average of $10,000 per year on childcare, we can’t afford to let this funding lapse without any plan to address this issue. In the short-term, our only solution is to continue support for child care stabilization grants.

86 percent of Americans agree: Congress must take action to pass affordable, accessible child care. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/childcare-reform-petition?contactdata=Cx01oE/8O1eWp1Ua53RBdj1fddH9k3704H59wbyshDPT202KkVc8ZHLBVvBCCRHRi2goXNbVgQoZwUnsEupfYfpe2r73mO+U8CCX59wsSLuUO/3ly9qQLecW9jBksYYAF9+XCCuhH5qGRyhtxg3kCg==]

Sign the Petition [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/childcare-reform-petition?contactdata=Cx01oE/8O1eWp1Ua53RBdj1fddH9k3704H59wbyshDPT202KkVc8ZHLBVvBCCRHRi2goXNbVgQoZwUnsEupfYfpe2r73mO+U8CCX59wsSLuUO/3ly9qQLecW9jBksYYAF9+XCCuhH5qGRyhtxg3kCg==]

The United States still fails to provide its working families with quality, affordable child care despite being one of the world’s richest democracies. If we provide families with exceptional childcare for just $10 a day, we would be investing in our children from the earliest stages of their lives, helping parents, strengthening our economy, and creating a solid foundation for generations to come.

We can and must do better. Tell Congress: We need $10 a day quality childcare. [https://act.rokhanna.com/a/childcare-reform-petition?contactdata=Cx01oE/8O1eWp1Ua53RBdj1fddH9k3704H59wbyshDPT202KkVc8ZHLBVvBCCRHRi2goXNbVgQoZwUnsEupfYfpe2r73mO+U8CCX59wsSLuUO/3ly9qQLecW9jBksYYAF9+XCCuhH5qGRyhtxg3kCg==]

In solidarity,
Ro

In this episode, Dr. Mansharamani speaks with Ashlee Vance, author of the recently released book "[When The Heavens Went on Sale: The Misfits and Geniuses Racing to Put Space Within Reach](https://r20.rs6.net/tn.jsp?f=001PQy6NJkVayq_S7eGFJIf7hueyi14RpK0rk8NpcfS7QKKGPP9mCoietshLLkv22Mz9aCGQUzCItLE8uyBpeQIaHmgl0QYlYyLxuShuOcZjIOySTA5KWn5CAgCicn7aPA2IjW7_TRvdId-qZeA94x5iw==&c=SJkwRAXwvKeY56GR0Sg0iWFRrlU7QMjJc0QDVUkRaxsujlINbsX0iQ==&ch=ZNN4yGblVSk3E4rEQMvLcqyXi1rAb0H7F-ZrZBKGoC0fYcuq4N3Pog==)." body:
With the leadership of Chairman Jim Walsh, our state party is going to start fighting again, we are going to take the fight to the Democrats...

http://wsrp.org
Ballots Are Out, Vote By November 2nd!

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=WeGlgXqOx-Y

With ballots out, now is the perfect time to get out there and volunteer on a conservative campaign. Every door you knock on in these local races matter a lot and the results of this election year will be used as a bellwether for the 2022 midterms.

We are also hosting another WSRP Statewide Day Of Action on Saturday, October 30th! Bring a friend or neighbor to volunteer for a few hours to help local conservatives win in November! Sign up here to join our Statewide Day Of Action! (https://form.jotform.com/212737084845058)
State Sen. Gildon On Vaccine Mandates
https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws
State Senator Chris Gildon (R - Puyallup) joins the podcast this week to discuss vaccine mandates, anti-policing laws, the Long-Term Care Tax, and how he got his start in politics. WAGOP is now on Apple Podcasts and Spotify, follow us and never miss an episode! Listen here. (https://soundcloud.com/user-450836972/wagop-report-state-sen-chris-gildon-on-vaccine-mandates-and-democrat-anti-policing-laws)
Republican Leaders Fight Inslee's Mandate
Thanks to our Republican leaders in the State House and Senate for fighting back and offering a strong rebuke of Inslee's harmful vaccine mandate. Below is an excerpt of their most recent statement to the press:

“We are already experiencing higher prices and empty shelves partially as a result of COVID's shutdowns and workforce shortages. Roger Williams is a Christian, conservative, pro-life, and second amendment supporter taking Texas values to Washington, D.C. He is a small business owner with over 45 years of experience and is running for Congress to create economic growth, jobs, and provide strong leadership. Roger worked alongside President Trump to fight against high taxes, rising energy prices, and soaring healthcare costs. His passion for conservative leadership led him to support Republican candidates from the White House to the county courthouse. | Meet **Mark Walker**

Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. Congressman Walker and his wife Kelly, a Family Nurse Practitioner and flight trauma specialist, have been married for thirty years and have three children.

disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY BECKY EDWARDS FOR CONGRESS
body:
Once we got on the primary ballot I started to notice something unique: a lot of our donors were women... | | | | |
---

Team Becky,
Once we got on the primary ballot I started to notice something unique: a lot of our donors were women! Small and large donations from across the district were coming in from women. From $1 to $9,900, I was amazed and grateful for the support we received throughout this state and district.
That observation gave me an idea that turned into a goal. [_**What if we could raise $100,000 from an all-women collective before the primary election?**_](https://beckyforutah.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9cc818aa94e94ffd36a8547b3&id=ee21fbc769&e=6484bb6dd5) We started to share that goal, donations kept coming in, and now we have reached that goal! In fact, we are nearing $150,000 in donations from women!
Women’s voices and votes have always mattered to me. To see so many women use their pocketbooks as a way to share their commitment to common sense politics is so inspiring. **Representation matters!**
I’ve also been inspired by the women throughout this district and state who understand the importance of collaborative politics and representation in our government. Together, your donations have powered our campaign–**and we will win on Tuesday!**
I’m inviting you to join us as we continue to build a coalition of women from across the district. These are women just like you, who are committed to better leadership in Congress. [**Will you donate today?**](https://beckyforutah.us14.list-manage.com/track/click?u=9cc818aa94e94ffd36a8547b3&id=dd3bd877a3&e=6484bb6dd5)
We’d love to include you. A donation of any amount would help me to continue to share my message throughout CD2!
Becky

name: Ilhan Omar
subject: I wish I didn’t have to ask, but please give me a chance to explain.
disclaimer_text: PAID FOR BY ILHAN FOR CONGRESS
body:
By far, the worst part of this job is the obscene amount of money that is spent on our elections.
# [](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/35?t=1&akid=496%2E791427%2EX8AY-4)

Friends —
I need to ask you to contribute $3 to my reelection before tonight's fundraising deadline. But before I do, will you give me a chance to explain why this request is so important?
The truth is that being a member of Congress, going to work representing my community and fighting for working people every day is truly one of the joys of my life. It's a privilege and an honor that I have never once taken for granted.
But it can be tough. By far, the worst part of this job is the obscene amount of money that is spent on our elections. It puts a huge pressure on me to make sure we have the resources necessary to run successful campaigns.
That’s why a lot of my colleagues take checks from corporate PACs, Wall Street billionaires, or fossil fuel companies without even thinking twice. They want the super PACs and the limitless spending in their races.
It's easy. But it’s corrupting our democracy and making elected officials more accountable to special interests than the people who elected them.
That’s not how I do things. I believe in grassroots movements. But this means I need to lean on you for support, especially today. So I wish I didn’t have to ask, but I know that winning reelection and making change in Washington requires all of us.
**[So if you can, will you please make your first contribution to my reelection before tonight’s deadline? This campaign is funded by lots of people giving small amounts at a time, so every dollar makes a difference.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-aug23.SAeyb4&refcode=em230831-1-t2&t=2&akid=496%2E791427%2EX8AY-4)**
Your support is what allows me to keep my time dialing for dollars to a minimum. It means I don’t have to beg corporate PACs and lobbyists.
Instead, I can dedicate my time to fighting for policies that help working people, supporting my constituents, and organizing to build power for our progressive movement.
Believe me when I say that your support is not something I take for granted. And I never will.
**[Thank you in advance for making a contribution before midnight if you can.](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-aug23.SAeyb4&refcode=em230831-1-t2&t=3&akid=496%2E791427%2EX8AY-4)**
**[CONTRIBUTE](https://act.ilhanomar.com/go/7?c0=io-em-aug23.SAeyb4&refcode=em230831-1-t2&t=4&akid=496%2E791427%2EX8AY-4)**
In solidarity,
Ilhan Omar

# [](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/61?t=1&akid=3648%2E5257348%2EGIIFF7)

Hi Derek,
It’s Eve Schiff.
Yes, Adam and Eve. And yes, we’ve heard all the jokes. Yes, that one, too.
But I’m reaching out today with an important ask: **[Can you chip in to Adam’s campaign for the United States Senate ahead of his big deadline tonight?](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1014?c0=aug2023_abs_em.G4DTRv&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20230831_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=5&akid=3648%2E5257348%2EGIIFF7)**
We have all watched Adam over the last six years. The work he’s done has been **so** important.
We watched as he **investigated** Trump. We watched as he led the **impeachment** trial against him. We watched his work on holding people accountable for January 6th. And now, we’re seeing that work result in not one, not two, but four indictments of Trump and his allies.
We also watched Adam as he was **ruthlessly** attacked.
By Trump. By Fox News. By Kevin McCarthy, Marjorie Taylor Greene, and by unscrupulous Republicans in Congress. He is pretty tough, and has weathered the storm well, but I’ll admit it — the viciousness of what he has endured concerns me.
**But he perseveres through these attacks, staying focused on his mission of delivering results for Californians and defending our democracy.**
This Senate campaign is a new challenge, and it has drawn new attacks — like the partisan censure vote a few months ago.
But if Adam is successful, it will also allow him to be an even more powerful defender of our democracy and its institutions. Because this isn’t about Trump. This is about the vision Adam has for the future of our state and country, and the vision that I know you share. Where right and truth and decency matter. And the oath of office means something.
Where the economy works for everyone, and everyone has a chance to succeed. Where parents can put their children to bed knowing they will be safe, knowing that if they get ill, they can get the care that they need, and knowing that the planet can be as healthy as they are.
**I believe that our country is filled with promise and that our democracy is precious.** And fragile. Adam has been on the frontlines, protecting it. He always will be. And you have always been by his side. I am so grateful for that.
I hope you will give him a huge show of support. It would mean so much to me. After all, we’re all in this fight together.
**[That’s why I’m asking. Can Adam and I count on you chipping in $10 right now?](https://act.adamschiff.com/go/1312?c0=aug2023_abs_em.iLceiL&refcode=AU_ABS_FR_GEN_EOM_AC90_20230831_PM1_V1_S1&email=&t=6&akid=3648%2E5257348%2EGIIFF7)**

subject: We need YOUR support, Peter
body:
We need to build the preparations now before Judge Hanen’s ruling. | | | Peter, We’ve been waiting for MONTHS for Judge Hanen’s decision on the future of DACA. Every day that passes is another day that DACA recipients live in limbo, unable to plan for the future. Our team will have little warning when his decision comes out. We’ll have to be ready to spring into action at a moment’s notice. That’s why we’re preparing right now for our response that day — **and it’s going to be big.**
* We’ll be facilitating gatherings to be in community with one another around the country.
* We’ll be holding a community call to share the facts and cut through any alarmist headlines or disinformation.
* We’ll be creating additional resources for DACA recipients and undocumented people. And so much more.

We’ll also be using the urgency of the moment to demand lawmakers finally provide permanent protections — a pathway to citizenship and not just band-aid solutions. We’ll need all our voices speaking together in unison to make sure our demands are heard, and President Biden and Congress deliver a solution that meets the moment. To do all this, and do it well, we need resources. We need YOUR support, Peter. **That’s why we’re asking: Will you donate today to fuel our fight for DACA recipients and all undocumented people? Every day that passes is another day that DACA recipients live in limbo, unable to plan for the future. Our team will have little warning when his decision comes out. We’ll have to be ready to spring into action at a moment’s notice. That’s why we’re preparing right now for our response that day — and it’s going to be big. We’ll be facilitating gatherings to be in community with one another around the country. We’ll be holding a community call to share the facts and cut through any alarmist headlines or disinformation. We’ll be creating additional resources for DACA recipients and undocumented people. And so much more. We’ll also be using the urgency of the moment to demand lawmakers finally provide permanent protections — a pathway to citizenship and not just band-aid solutions. We’ll need all our voices speaking together in unison to make sure our demands are heard, and President Biden and Congress deliver a solution that meets the moment. Friends — I am coming to you this morning with a humble request:
At midnight tonight, our campaign faces an important end-of-month fundraising deadline. If you have $5, $10, or even $100 to contribute, I would genuinely appreciate it.
Please use this link to donate:
**[https://secure.actblue.com/donate/rg-em-aug23](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68999847/424775078/1133484937?refcode2=03e51206-2448-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&refcode=em230831-1-t2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwM2U1MTIwNi0yNDQ4LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1YzRbRUji-RTaPjaLCw2S-kSjOvq5y8zb0gPZgC71lM=)**
As a gay Latino immigrant, most would’ve never expected someone like myself to end up as a member of Congress. But over the past 8 months, I have received an outpouring of love from people across the country who feel like they _finally_ have someone who represents them. And it’s a humbling experience.
I’ve fought long and hard since the start of my term in the House — to protect our planet, for working families, and accountability of lawmakers. And I am grateful to have had this team stand by my side every step of the way.
**But here’s the truth: My team reached out to me earlier this week letting me know that we are pacing behind our August fundraising goals. I am concerned. Concerned that our movement is losing momentum.**
The reality is campaigns are expensive. But we cannot let money stop us from fighting for working families, immigrants, LGBTQ+ communities, and everyone in between across California and America.
So I am reaching out to you for your support because we need the resources to aid our movement in supporting candidates that can and will take back the House majority. Electing more Democrats to Congress is how we can protect our most important freedoms.
**[If you can today, please make a contribution to my campaign for Congress before we reach our August end-of-month deadline at midnight. I would not ask if it weren’t so important.](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/68999848/424775079/1133484937?refcode2=03e51206-2448-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&refcode=em230831-1-t2&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTIvMS85MTcxOSIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIwM2U1MTIwNi0yNDQ4LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=1YzRbRUji-RTaPjaLCw2S-kSjOvq5y8zb0gPZgC71lM=)**
Thank you in advance for you contribution and for being a part of this team.

Peter, I grew up across the street from one of Donald Trump's golf courses in New York. This one, in fact: ↘↘ [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69000333/424776743/-717493931?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20230831_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZTIwMWNiNy0yNDQ4LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4wdC5JG6HxZNExMq-WD_dPBhnzDMU83O0rs1qEd74X4=) Yes, really. But it was not the way I think you're picturing it in your mind — let me explain.

I didn't live in a skyrise apartment or a mansion with luxuries at my fingertips.

**I grew up in the Throggs Neck Houses, a crumbling public housing project among vermin, lead, and mold, across from Trump's Golf Course in The Bronx.** [](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69000334/424776745/-717493931?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20230831_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZTIwMWNiNy0yNDQ4LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4wdC5JG6HxZNExMq-WD_dPBhnzDMU83O0rs1qEd74X4=) My mom was a single mom, working multiple jobs to keep food on the table. I'm so grateful for how much she sacrificed to provide for our family.

Living across from Trump's Golf Course, I had to see a reminder every day of how easily and often our government supports and enables the ultra-wealthy at the expense of working families.

You see, the New York City government shoveled over _$100 million in government aid_ to develop this golf course with Donald Trump and the corrupt Trump Organization. _They did this while New York families like mine lived in hunger and poverty across the street._

But, I always try to look at the positives — growing up smelling the stench of Donald Trump (even before he became president) has led me to where I am today: **Fighting in Congress for justice for real working families.**

When I work on legislation, I always think about the families who are struggling just like mine did. I lived that experience — it is not abstract to me. And I'll never forget it.

I hope you feel like you have a better sense of who I am and what my values are. I swear that I'm fighting for those values every day in Congress.

Right now, the shadow of Trump and his MAGA cult looms large. They're determined to strip our right to vote, give tax breaks to people like Trump, and put special interests ahead of working families _– and they’re raising millions to pull it off._

But we have something they don’t, Peter: A powerful grassroots movement made up of working people, not faceless corporations. [**Can I count on you to join our coalition today by chipping in $3 toward tonight's $10,000 August goal? If thousands of people like you each chip in what they can afford, I know we can take on their dark money and reclaim our House Majority. »**](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69000336/424776746/-717493931?amount=3&refcode=RTFC_20230831_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZTIwMWNiNy0yNDQ4LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4wdC5JG6HxZNExMq-WD_dPBhnzDMU83O0rs1qEd74X4=) If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | [CONTRIBUTE $3 »](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69000347/424776757/-717493931?amount=3&express_lane=true&refcode=RTFC_20230831_EMDF_E1_T0_AC_RS&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMDcvMS83NjE2MiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICI4ZTIwMWNiNy0yNDQ4LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=4wdC5JG6HxZNExMq-WD_dPBhnzDMU83O0rs1qEd74X4=)

clean_body: | = Peter, I grew up across the street from one of Donald Trump's golf courses in New York. This one, in fact: ↘↘ = Yes, really. But it was not the way I think you're picturing it in your mind — let me explain. I didn't live in a skyrise apartment or a mansion with luxuries at my fingertips. I grew up in the Throggs Neck Houses, a crumbling public housing project among vermin, lead, and mold, across from Trump's Golf Course in The Bronx. = My mom was a single mom, working multiple jobs to keep food on the table. I'm so grateful for how much she sacrificed to provide for our family. Living across from Trump's Golf Course, I had to see a reminder every day of how easily and often our government supports and enables the ultra-wealthy at the expense of working families. You see, the New York City government shoveled over $100 million in government aid to develop this golf course with Donald Trump and the corrupt Trump Organization. They did this while New York families like mine lived in hunger and poverty across the street. But, I always try to look at the positives — growing up smelling the stench of Donald Trump (even before he became president) has led me to where I am today: Fighting in Congress for justice for real working families. When I work on legislation, I always think about the families who are struggling just like mine did. I lived that experience — it is not abstract to me. And I'll never forget it. I hope you feel like you have a better sense of who I am and what my values are. I swear that I'm fighting for those values every day in Congress. Right now, the shadow of Trump and his MAGA cult looms large. They're determined to strip our right to vote, give tax breaks to people like Trump, and put special interests ahead of working families – and they’re raising millions to pull it off. But we have something they don’t, Peter: A powerful grassroots movement made up of working people, not faceless corporations. = If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your donation will go through immediately: | = = = Thank you, Ritchie | | Paid for by Torres For Congress PO Box 580303, Bronx, NY 10458 www.torres.nyc Ritchie Torres represents the future of the Democratic Party. It’s Senator Ted Cruz with a serious message for you today: Democrats are coming for me like they’ve never gone after anyone before; they want me gone. We cannot give them the satisfaction of defeating me, no matter what.

I’m desperately in need of your help. I’m fighting a war on two fronts.

If that weren’t enough, a relatively new super PAC calling itself _“Lose Cruz”_ has made commitments to spend millions on _“good old-fashioned attacks”_ **to expose all my** _“deplorable actions and the consequences of them.”_

[**I need your help IMMEDIATELY.**](http://links.conservativesdefendingfreedom.com/u/click?_t=91d01aa68bbe4105984439520ca0f0af&_m=c5043575a0e641a68707576420229f7f&_e=-i16jPed8SG58DDg3PTMR5QlO4_MuP5dONeU7mu5glb_PhldBxZ6yT-UldlfZ0VccuYUKCOVWYKvnvH2IAGtdcYxzA6pXDjaTciEBARjcE6V2O5kefqq2_dJVF03gsN3mNZ_0e23Bv351lympRf7zxt_s7xUk2JsSYAYh2yg_lOUPnN_TajpYSrC3U29WHFKaV7aHq4j3xN92-vDaHESPTFPcr44q-Log5Tc1p_qfuQXc_q0346OVxeIlcoQ3nqNs7VuY5DLHsyLw2MPsxdyCRLwUtafNIDNk5Iqc_Fy44-VOGtY6L2CBTdVCuXh0PZRZohkNHhyc183T3ZFcgk4DIhqHvyHuprBH7_yabc6tT8b8eLu_Y2QpUPRUXMb0xNI1WRjDma_rnC3iH_Raz5I4f9Z4-vOBh9V0kKTRiuURGKOklo4yF1wKNBOf3ggwB3e)

**This is SERIOUS.**We cannot win back the Senate majority without a win in Texas.****

**Democrats are putting up a far-left candidate they think has enough wide-ranging appeal to beat me. What’s more, they’re putting their money where their mouth is.**

I don’t want to alarm you, but it’s critical we step up our fundraising game NOW. I’m going to need MILLIONS to defend myself from the never-ending attacks against me. Should we fail to rise to the occasion, I could very well lose this Senate seat.

| Peter -
As one of my most loyal and committed supporters, I wanted to send a quick note before the August fundraising deadline to express my gratitude for your generous help.
I know that this time of the year you are being bombarded with fundraising emails, text messages, phone calls, and everything else from politicians asking you to donate to their campaigns.
I am sure it can be overwhelming, and hard to tell who is being honest, who is using cheap tricks and gimmicks, who is communicating a positive vision, and, ultimately, who you should send your hard-earned money to.
My hope is that my messages to you have been useful and substantive, and that I've explained in detail how I use every dollar you send me to further our conservative movement. Let me share with you all that we've been able to accomplish TOGETHER thanks to your generous support.
We're able to communicate with millions of people across the country, with persuasive messaging on key issues that are at the heart of some of the most heated debates in America. I know our messaging campaigns on energy, climate change, border security, taking on the cartels, and so much more have brought more people to our side and that wouldn't be possible without your help.
We're able to hold our Crenshaw Youth Summit in Texas, attracting thousands of young, active Americans from across the country to Houston for a weekend of fun, informative discussions that are meant to persuade young people to join the conservative movement. I truly believe these Youth Summits are ensuring the continued success of our movement for generations to come.
And, importantly, I'm able to stay in Congress and fight for the issues that matter to you. I take my legislative work seriously in Washington, passing bills to boost American energy production, reduce government spending and waste, secure our border and destroy the Mexican drug cartels.

clean_body: | | | | | | | | | | | Peter - As one of my most loyal and committed supporters, I wanted to send a quick note before the August fundraising deadline to express my gratitude for your generous help. I know that this time of the year you are being bombarded with fundraising emails, text messages, phone calls, and everything else from politicians asking you to donate to their campaigns. I am sure it can be overwhelming, and hard to tell who is being honest, who is using cheap tricks and gimmicks, who is communicating a positive vision, and, ultimately, who you should send your hard-earned money to. My hope is that my messages to you have been useful and substantive, and that I've explained in detail how I use every dollar you send me to further our conservative movement. Let me share with you all that we've been able to accomplish TOGETHER thanks to your generous support. We're able to communicate with millions of people across the country, with persuasive messaging on key issues that are at the heart of some of the most heated debates in America. I know our messaging campaigns on energy, climate change, border security, taking on the cartels, and so much more have brought more people to our side and that wouldn't be possible without your help. We're able to hold our Crenshaw Youth Summit in Texas, attracting thousands of young, active Americans from across the country to Houston for a weekend of fun, informative discussions that are meant to persuade young people to join the conservative movement. I truly believe these Youth Summits are ensuring the continued success of our movement for generations to come. And, importantly, I'm able to stay in Congress and fight for the issues that matter to you. name: Tara McGowan
subject: We're expanding!
body:
There's a lot to be excited about.
# [](https://act.couriernewsroom.com/go/83?t=1&akid=1490%2E120351%2EecJidO)
Hi, Peter, it's Tara McGowan, Founder and Publisher of Courier Newsroom.
I recently spoke with Axios about our plans for 2024 and beyond — and there’s _a lot_ to be excited about!
[](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230831?refcode=em20230831&amount=&refcode2=1490_120351_ecJidO&akid=1490%2E120351%2EecJidO)
**I'll share more in a moment, but if you're short on time,[will you take a second to pitch in $5 before tonight's end-of-month deadline to help us open more newsrooms and bring reliable, fact-based journalism to even more states?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230831?refcode=em20230831&amount=5&refcode2=1490_120351_ecJidO&akid=1490%2E120351%2EecJidO)
**[Donate $5 »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230831?refcode=em20230831&amount=5&refcode2=1490_120351_ecJidO&akid=1490%2E120351%2EecJidO)**
America is facing a growing information crisis. Local news is collapsing across the country — with more than 400 newspapers having shuttered since 2019. Many communities are now left without a reliable source of local news. This means that critical issues like school and hospital board meetings, or the impacts of floods, or droughts on residents are going unreported.
The result is that right-wing disinformation is spreading like wildfire. With the 2024 presidential cycle ramping up, we’re going to continue to see a rise in new and targeted misinformation campaigns to influence different communities and sow doubt and divisions in our democracy.
And that’s what makes our work at COURIER so important. Misinformation spreads fastest when people don’t have easy access to the truth. The information void is now being filled by right-wing groups spreading misinformation and lies to advance their extreme partisan agenda.
COURIER is fighting back. Our sole mission is to neutralize misinformation in the spaces it typically thrives, by delivering quality local reporting to the communities that need it the most. Our network of newsrooms in nine key battleground states doesn’t follow the same profit-driven playbook as the mainstream media. That means we don’t hide our stories behind paywalls or publish sensational stories to boost ad revenue.
As the 2024 election approaches, we’re in a unique position to combat the spread of bad information with good information in as many states as possible. That’s why we recently opened up a newsroom in Nevada—and it’s why we plan on opening up **_two more**_ newsrooms by the end of 2023.
But opening a newsroom isn’t easy and it certainly isn’t cheap. It takes time and resources to hire journalists and build a network of readers.
And that's why I'm asking you: [**Will you pitch in $5 before tonight's end-of-month fundraising deadline to expand COURIER's reach and open more newsrooms this year?**](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230831?refcode=em20230831&amount=5&refcode2=1490_120351_ecJidO&akid=1490%2E120351%2EecJidO)
**[Donate $5 now »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-courier-20230831?refcode=em20230831&amount=5&refcode2=1490_120351_ecJidO&akid=1490%2E120351%2EecJidO)**
Thank you!
Tara McGowan
Founder & Publisher
Courier Newsroom
**[DONATE »](https://secure.actblue.com/donate/em-footer?refcode=em-footer--1490&t=2&refcode2=1490_120351_ecJidO&akid=1490%2E120351%2EecJidO)**
Email us: [**info@couriernewsroom.com**](mailto:info@couriernewsroom.com)
This email was sent to dpwillis67@gmail.com. Email is a critical way we communicate with grassroots supporters like you. However, if you would like to change your subscription preferences, here are some options:

body:
Hi Peter,

I promise that this is the last email I’ll send you before our August deadline expires. I know my team and I have been updating you about the campaign constantly, and I appreciate your support in this exciting time.

It’s been a busy summer in our campaign for CA-27 -- we’ve received endorsements from Rep. Adam Schiff, critical local organizations like the Santa Clarita Democratic Club, and from people like you. These early endorsements signal that the district is coming together behind our campaign.

We have put GOP Rep. Mike Garcia on notice: Our movement to turn CA-27 blue and win the House majority for our communities is growing by the day, hour, and minute.

That’s why it is so important we finish these summer months out strong. Our team set a $15,000 online fundraising goal, and as of 11 AM, we’re just shy of hitting the mark.

If you’re able, can I count on you to chip in $3 before midnight? Here’s a personalized link to donate: [https://secure.actblue.com/donate/gw-q3-2023](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69010861/424793320/-1766409733?refcode=em-8.31.23-all-a&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMzAvMS85MDE1MyIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICJkMWY0NzUwOC0zMDQ4LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=ZMPmhfXYYf632oMjFR-2Nw7TJx481r_HPobq61GK8RI=)

This summer and the start of our campaign has proved to be a worthwhile learning experience. I’m energized by our Santa Clarita and Antelope Valley communities -- and I know together we can shock Garcia next November.

Despite our efforts, this will not be an easy fight. Mike Garcia is the last Republican standing in Congress representing Los Angeles County, and the full might of national Republican dark money is already aligning behind him.

But right now, all I care about is growing this grassroots campaign the best we can. And that requires an influx of donations before midnight tonight -- I hope I will see your name on our list of supporters chipping in before the deadline.

body:
Friend, it's time to raise our voices as one and DEMAND gender equity — will you join us?
| | |
---
**DEVELOPING FROM WASHINGTON:**
**Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand introduces a resolution to certify the Equal Rights Amendment and enshrine reproductive rights in the Constitution.**
Friend, the Equal Rights Amendment (ERA) would establish that our civil rights cannot be infringed upon or taken away on the basis of gender. Activists have been fighting for nearly 100 years to add this amendment to our Constitution — and we can't wait any longer.
Since Kirsten announced this resolution, so many Democrats have already added their names to stand with her and show their support for the ERA. Now, we've set a HUGE end-of-month goal to reach 75,000 signatures, and we're counting on your help to do it!
**[Please, friend, it's time to raise our voices as one and DEMAND gender equity — will you join us?](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69012871/424800405/-1770068183?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=43614&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk4407-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYWUwMTJjNi0zNDQ4LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5iBWNJvDHschon-4DghS95NBT_QLIlQM_3oc4sDTgYQ=&emci=09e156e3-9746-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=3ae012c6-3448-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=7659029)**

| | [SIGN THE PETITION](https://click.ngpvan.com/k/69012872/424800406/-1770068183?email=dpwillis67@gmail.com&zip=43614&amounts=5,25,50,100&code=jtk4407-su-nd&nvep=ew0KICAiVGVuYW50VXJpIjogIm5ncHZhbjovL3Zhbi9OR1AvTkdQMTkvMS83MjcyMiIsDQogICJEaXN0cmlidXRpb25VbmlxdWVJZCI6ICIzYWUwMTJjNi0zNDQ4LWVlMTEtYTNmMS0wMDIyNDgzMmViNzMiLA0KICAiRW1haWxBZGRyZXNzIjogImRwd2lsbGlzNjdAZ21haWwuY29tIg0KfQ%3D%3D&hmac=5iBWNJvDHschon-4DghS95NBT_QLIlQM_3oc4sDTgYQ=&emci=09e156e3-9746-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&emdi=3ae012c6-3448-ee11-a3f1-00224832eb73&ceid=7659029)

When the Supreme Court overturned Roe v. Wade, they took away the right for half of the population to access the health care they need. It's discrimination based on sex — plain and simple. **Adding the ERA to our Constitution would give us a legal basis to restore reproductive rights across the entire country.**
Right now, we're closer than ever before to certifying the ERA: 38 states have ratified it, and it's just one signature away from being added to the Constitution. _But an arbitrary deadline is stopping us from finally certifying this amendment!_
**That's why Sen. Kirsten Gillibrand has introduced new legislation that would establish that this deadline should _not_ stop us from certifying the ERA. **With bipartisan support and filibuster reform, we can pass this legislation, finally establish gender equality in our Constitution and restore reproductive freedoms nationwide.

_**The GOP's Future Lies With Its Populist Base | Opinion**_ By Bobby Jindal and Alex Castellanos
---
The old Republican establishment still doesn't get it, does it? Many Republican candidates and critics remain dumbfounded that 's plague of indictments and abundance of personal shortcomings have not loosened his grip on the party. But working-class Republican men and women do not have the luxury of a nonstop anti-Trump sideshow. They are losing their children to woke educators, their freedom of speech to political correctness, and their communities to evaporating law enforcement. They fear they are losing their country. And only one blue-collar billionaire has stood up for them. Lecturing these despairing voters that they need to hate Trump is just a way for yesterday's Republican leaders to avoid culpability. Trump filled the vacuum these left, and his critics will not displace our former president until they fill that vacuum better than he has. Who failed so miserably for all those years when Republicans could have provided an alternative to the decline of America? Was it Donald Trump? No, it was the old Republican establishment. But railing that Trump is a bad man and voters should hate the bad man allows them to feel noble about themselves instead of confronting their failures. **[FINISH READING ON NEWSWEEK.COM](http://links.americanxt.com/u/click?_t=45ea7b9dcedb45198104e7ca02a78270&_m=762a4f905c424b929eafe59844fe212c&_e=aOB61vHeBijhwF_B87OpuR9k3Hl6FdBuufi3slra0C6_JtWZFmvmihHgNJiWCqxIr70Rc9vp_3Ja0bINC0aVAsulDeTWQlNK-4xhT1gugUi7XUHo1Y4Ubmay9PAjbM68VO4r-2RfncehlrNvN32KjewhCzapOkFnzZqxATk9Q9M8ZRUoDMBncoshwGfZVDYz5XHxK7F51k1NawUUtqqC2kwZwnnnGZKvNbxTpwLXt5P9VMTtp2pdgYTZIQp0iXAAxRgcyrcfr6wcgnH3GgL1ng%3D%3D)**

subject: Recap of our recent town hall and an introduction to our Lancaster & Berks team!
disclaimer_text: Paid for by the New Pennsylvania Project
body:
https://secure.everyaction.com/DQ7Hxcpq3Eabel6LA-9V0Q2?refcode=newsletter [https://secure.everyaction.com/DQ7Hxcpq3Eabel6LA-9V0Q2?refcode=newsletter]
Hello friends!
We hope this edition of the New Pennsylvania Project eBlast finds you well.
Please take a few moments to check out all the important news you can use, events happening in your neighborhood, career opportunities, and other updates.
Welcome Tauhida!
Graphic welcoming Tauhida Smith [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AV001/1/90920/images/NPP%20Social.jpg]
NPP CEO Kadida Kenner is excited to announce the addition of Tauhida Smith to the New Pennsylvania Project organizing team!
Tauhida Smith is the new Regional Organizing Director for the Berks/Lancaster region.
Coupled with her background in organizational leadership and development, Tauhida has over 15 years of cumulative experience in campaign management, program development, and strategic team building. As an alumna from Millersville University and resident of Reading, Pa., Tauhida encompasses a deep passion for civic engagement and voter outreach within her region. She is a relationship-oriented leader enthralled with building a conducive and unique work environment geared towards maximizing opportunities for community engagement, development, and growth.
Meet our entire team: https://www.newpaproject.org/npp-team/ [https://www.newpaproject.org/npp-team/]
Nitty Gritty Event Recap
Images from the Nitty Gritty event [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AV001/1/90920/images/Untitled%20design_2.png]
We wanted to extend a HUGE thank you to everyone who joined us, along with our friends at The Leadership Conference on Civil and Human Rights, as well as POWER Interfaith, at our Nitty Gritty of Building an Equal Justice Judiciary town hall in Philadelphia on Wed. Aug. 23!
There were close to 100 people in attendance and we were blown away with the conversations happening -- not just on our panel but with an incredibly engaged community.
If you weren't able to join us in Philadelphia but would like to listen to the conversation that was had, a video of the town hall can be found here [https://fb.watch/mJUiOesFnG/] .
Also be on the lookout for similar events being announced shortly for other areas of Pennsylvania!
Tweet of the Week
Speaking of our Nitty Gritty event, a big thank you to U.S. Representative Dwight Evans for speaking at our event and for the announcement he made just one day later on Twitter. We'll let the Tweet speak for itself as a reminder on why we do this work and the difference we can make.
Tweet from U.S. Rep Dwight Evans on his co-sponsorship of the Supreme Court Ethics, Recusal, and Transparency Act [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AV001/1/90920/images/IMG_0139.jpg]
NPP in the News
140 Judges Later: Senate Democrats Work To Diversify the Federal Judiciary [https://www.democracydocket.com/analysis/140-judges-later-senate-democrats-work-to-diversify-the-federal-judiciary/]
(Democracy Docket)
The CEO of New Pennsylvania Project, a Commonwealth-based voting rights organization, Kadida Kenner contextualized these diverse confirmations in a statement to Democracy Docket, “92 of the [federal] judges identify as belonging to communities of color (almost 67%) compared to the Trump administration that appointed a paltry 14% judges of color, with the majority being white, male and unqualified.”
Instagram of the Week
Instagram post with a quote from Kadida Kenner [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AV001/1/90920/images/IMG_0140.jpg]
Court Corner
Leading up to the Nov. 7th election, we'll be bringing you important news articles and information on the judicial elections that are sure to have a huge impact on the future of Pennsylvania. #CourtsMatter
The Latest Legal Challenge to Reform-Minded Prosecutors [https://www.brennancenter.org/our-work/analysis-opinion/latest-legal-challenge-reform-minded-prosecutors]
(Brennan Center for Justice)
This fall, the Pennsylvania Supreme Court will hear arguments on whether state lawmakers can impeach Philadelphia District Attorney Larry Krasner, who is accused of “misbehavior in office” for pursuing various criminal justice reform policies. Earlier this year, a closely divided state court panel blocked the bid by Pennsylvania house Republicans to remove Krasner — thwarting the latest in a series of attacks around the country on the efforts of some prosecutors to use their power to check the criminal justice system’s perceived excesses.
Scenes from the Ground
We wanted to close our bi-weekly eBlast on a high note by featuring just a few of the recent images we've collected from our work across the Commonwealth. We look forward to engaging with Pennsylvanians from every corner of our state over the coming months!
Images showing individuals getting registered to vote [https://prod.cdn.everyaction.com/images/van/AV/AV001/1/90920/images/Untitled%20design_3.png]
Thank you for taking the time to stay informed. We'll be back in two weeks with the latest edition.
In solidarity,
#TeamNPP
PA ELECTION DATES:
Municipal/Local/Judicial Election: November 7, 2023
Last day to register to vote : October 23, 2023
Last day to request a mail-in or absentee ballot : October 31, 2023
We're on a mission to register new voters in the Commonwealth and expand the electorate.
Help us prepare for the upcoming municipal, judicial, and local elections in 2023!
Invest in our democracy [https://secure.everyaction.com/DQ7Hxcpq3Eabel6LA-9V0Q2?emci=94765bbc-8d5e-ec11-94f6-0050f2e65e9b&emdi=ea000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001&ceid=1068162]

Now he's playing the same game with the nation's budget. Perry won't be happy until America's bond rating falls again. Unlike Perry, I will restore regular order and keep America at the top of the world's financial pyramid. As long as Scott Perry and the Freedom Caucus can leverage a GOP House majority to advance their unpopular, dangerous, and misguided agenda, our communities will be left behind. body:
I’m standing with my sister in service, Congresswoman Ayanna Pressley, after she faced a racist, anti-Black attack from a GOP presidential candidate this week. | |
---
Peter, This weekend, a GOP presidential candidate called Congresswoman Ayanna Pressley -- my sister in service -- a leader of the modern KKK. This disturbing remark invoking a group responsible for anti-Black massacres is an unacceptable smear against a leader for racial justice, alongside whom I am proud to serve. Let’s be clear: **Ayanna and I are the first Black women elected to Congress from our states.** Since Congress was founded, 1,700 members of Congress have enslaved Black people -- that’s more than the number of Black people who’ve ever served in Congress. Our country was founded on anti-Blackness and white supremacy, which is still entrenched today. 10 out of the first 12 US presidents all enslaved Black people, and one even traded and sold Black people from the Oval Office. **Our work to eradicate white supremacy is ongoing.** **Over the past few days, we’ve mourned deadly anti-Black attacks after a year of rising hate crimes against Black people, enabled by racist and hate-filled rhetoric and policies.** We just marked the 68th anniversary of Emmett Till’s murder, and we’re still under the threat of white supremacist violence today. We also marked the 60th anniversary of the March on Washington for Jobs and Freedom, where civil rights movement heroes marched for equal jobs, fair wages, and freedom from white supremacy. Amidst hate and dehumanization, we're still fighting for those ideals today. And we'll keep legislating to make them a reality. **As Black women in Congress, Ayanna and I have faced a particular type of hate: misogynoir.** **But our very existence is a celebration of life and resistance to oppression. We continue to lead with love as we work to prevent hateful violence, advance justice, and create a society that values people’s lives and well-being.** [**Will you chip in today to support Ayanna Pressley’s campaign and mine as we carry forward the legacy of movements for Black liberation and Black lives?**](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953z3gxnqkzEqIMNVVxfHI45dJGO-QpGDMpoPJDN2Pb4C_H6Es5Y1TrI18-YliYd7sm3gtTkOY9MLwW07lZt8-mK0JSeezg9lMD4uGnmE8dAlm1x8__jkt3tZQ8qPEmFshgGr9Id4x70kIAU0YYqQPb6-5PHhFm6sge8YfHZDZSqOsMd7PjxdSnyhvPrNdOAUTCc1-7baYxNK8b0wKmCh6Cu5SVoqjOf0-c-uJICZlhmpYX67EQ84jCm0GBOZDlFjNrP0Rf2tAZrRLJg5cDQPXqguHIyp41uJnPvJ6h4UvtgF21O0jX_9ih2ykGHSqjMH1_qeD3nYe8qu8VnJQfofO9rtG830C-SdkYWW8SDP14MDw67HOEOb2iO4rvBNvQNcxiQAR7LjWj_Q15V0oI3obC7cnQCJtiEfG7WzSehQuAhiIg/3z7/2WJS76CeT5urwLZks8qPzw/h0/lp3mV6TevK8yAriU7FJAUSXl60o3gT-WEwOFGxFIAO8) **[DONATE NOW](https://click.actionnetwork.org/ss/c/wehEm_vu1NBVXOKYSqOxTOi34aJoCJC1EivM7Ih953z3gxnqkzEqIMNVVxfHI45dJGO-QpGDMpoPJDN2Pb4C_Eq0VwV_1C2GT8Ls-xvzT5oljou3HaRlCod6wNQUAux-nz7cFtZX5sOjfGq2o7H2rKwrRMiR61fXKEjz6mUI_Nq7ojLRNxyWB9HapC3OuNBBrHnHQDzWOPJTdwiwgCWnj9TousYgJiInOfcK-PpN7JLYs9d4ysC9JRj0W1lWPLW_Hcnpw550pkzwUEh5ja72lNpO5MFZctxdYezgQbdeN_VoIsJ1ZkSQBpj-D-SxnZnCWZGQsqr-K3V4w1pdT90kxbkzdO63CLsJ6TiXJa5yNvQibKK_QO3VEHxh2qZ8amTOe6uvh2muGGadwgcclzqtn7MmtbXD8wYEsEjUwAuQz5HY_O3uLeFdXI59w5SN-WLvzyerUB_cSFLyNuDoVnXcTA/3z7/2WJS76CeT5urwLZks8qPzw/h1/uI8ZjTcx5vWBz_jvj1mwwmd64ZBFAsgLO6T7-w1YceA) ** **I’ve worked with my sister in service Ayanna Pressley on legislation like the**** _Abortion Justice Act_** , which removes systemic barriers to abortion care that disproportionately harm Black women. **Together, we’ve introduced bills for housing justice** , like the _Housing Emergencies Lifeline Program (HELP) Act_ , to support low-income renters. After centuries of disparities and dehumanization, the racial wealth gap is widening and the unhoused crisis is getting worse, with Black renters disproportionately vulnerable to eviction. Ayanna and I have championed bills like the _People’s Response Act_ to **transform our systems of public safety and institute systems of care rather than criminalization****.** And Ayanna co-sponsored my _Reparations Now Resolution_ , which affirms that the U.S. federal government has a moral and legal obligation to provide **reparations to the descendants of enslaved people** in this country. **As Black women progressives in Congress, Ayanna and I carry in our hearts the Black women activists and leaders who sparked movements before us** \-- including those who championed the Equal Rights Amendment, which is still an essential tool to achieve health equity and eliminate the racial and gender wealth gap. Together, Ayanna and I are leading the push to make the Equal Rights Amendment an official part of the Constitution, and we’re advocating to cancel student debt, which disproportionately burdens Black borrowers -- especially Black women. We know that each issue is intersectional, and we understand how urgently our communities need change. clean_body: I’m standing with my sister in service, Congresswoman Ayanna Pressley, after she faced a racist, anti-Black attack from a GOP presidential candidate this week. | | Peter, This weekend, a GOP presidential candidate called Congresswoman Ayanna Pressley -- my sister in service -- a leader of the modern KKK. This disturbing remark invoking a group responsible for anti-Black massacres is an unacceptable smear against a leader for racial justice, alongside whom I am proud to serve. Let’s be clear: Ayanna and I are the first Black women elected to Congress from our states. Since Congress was founded, 1,700 members of Congress have enslaved Black people -- that’s more than the number of Black people who’ve ever served in Congress. Our country was founded on anti-Blackness and white supremacy, which is still entrenched today. 10 out of the first 12 US presidents all enslaved Black people, and one even traded and sold Black people from the Oval Office. Our work to eradicate white supremacy is ongoing. Over the past few days, we’ve mourned deadly anti-Black attacks after a year of rising hate crimes against Black people, enabled by racist and hate-filled rhetoric and policies. We just marked the 68th anniversary of Emmett Till’s murder, and we’re still under the threat of white supremacist violence today. We also marked the 60th anniversary of the March on Washington for Jobs and Freedom, where civil rights movement heroes marched for equal jobs, fair wages, and freedom from white supremacy. Amidst hate and dehumanization, we're still fighting for those ideals today. And we'll keep legislating to make them a reality. As Black women in Congress, Ayanna and I have faced a particular type of hate: misogynoir. But our very existence is a celebration of life and resistance to oppression. We continue to lead with love as we work to prevent hateful violence, advance justice, and create a society that values people’s lives and well-being. I’ve worked with my sister in service Ayanna Pressley on legislation like the Abortion Justice Act , which removes systemic barriers to abortion care that disproportionately harm Black women. Together, we’ve introduced bills for housing justice , like the Housing Emergencies Lifeline Program (HELP) Act , to support low-income renters. After centuries of disparities and dehumanization, the racial wealth gap is widening and the unhoused crisis is getting worse, with Black renters disproportionately vulnerable to eviction. Ayanna and I have championed bills like the People’s Response Act to transform our systems of public safety and institute systems of care rather than criminalization. And Ayanna co-sponsored my Reparations Now Resolution , which affirms that the U.S. federal government has a moral and legal obligation to provide reparations to the descendants of enslaved people in this country. As Black women progressives in Congress, Ayanna and I carry in our hearts the Black women activists and leaders who sparked movements before us \-- including those who championed the Equal Rights Amendment, which is still an essential tool to achieve health equity and eliminate the racial and gender wealth gap. Together, Ayanna and I are leading the push to make the Equal Rights Amendment an official part of the Constitution, and we’re advocating to cancel student debt, which disproportionately burdens Black borrowers -- especially Black women. We know that each issue is intersectional, and we understand how urgently our communities need change. ** If you've saved your payment information with ActBlue Express, your secure donation will go through immediately, split evenly between Cori Bush and Ayanna Pressley: | | | | | | | | | | We are not giving up or turning back. | The Biden Admin's latest antics have taken a turn for the absurd, as they set their sights on none other than... ceiling fans.

That's right, while they seem to disregard lines when it comes to following the law, they're all in when it comes to controlling what lightbulb you can buy and even banning your beloved gas stove, water heater and now... ceiling fan!
---
| [ ](https://mcshanellc.us21.list-manage.com/track/click?u=1d82dcd2e67c4075340c26b37&id=1761427112&e=25844e23a8)
---
| The Department of Energy is proposing rules that would force ceiling fan manufacturers to jump through expensive hoops to make their products more energy efficient.

Sure, they claim it's for the greater good and might save households a whopping $39 over the lifespan of a new fan.

_But guess what?_ The cost to manufacturers for these changes would be a staggering $86.6 million per year!

It's a classic case of government intervention gone haywire. While the Biden administration talks a big game about helping the environment, they conveniently forget that they're hurting the very businesses that drive our local economies. This kind of top-down control threatens small manufacturers and our fellow citizens' livelihoods, putting up to 30 percent of small business ceiling fan manufacturers out of business. We can't let that happen.

This is why it's absolutely essential that we rally together and support Conservative candidates who will stand against these profit-driven, freedom-sapping initiatives by Big Government. We need leaders who will fight for common-sense solutions, not bureaucrats who think they know what's best for our homes and businesses.

**Peter, we also must exercise our Free Speech to show how much we see through the climate crazed agenda that is more about DOMINATION and DOLLARS than saving the environment!**

Sure, they claim it's for the greater good and might save households a whopping $39 over the lifespan of a new fan. But guess what? The cost to manufacturers for these changes would be a staggering $86.6 million per year! It's a classic case of government intervention gone haywire. While the Biden administration talks a big game about helping the environment, they conveniently forget that they're hurting the very businesses that drive our local economies. This kind of top-down control threatens small manufacturers and our fellow citizens' livelihoods, putting up to 30 percent of small business ceiling fan manufacturers out of business. We can't let that happen. This is why it's absolutely essential that we rally together and support Conservative candidates who will stand against these profit-driven, freedom-sapping initiatives by Big Government. We need leaders who will fight for common-sense solutions, not bureaucrats who think they know what's best for our homes and businesses. Peter, we also must exercise our Free Speech to show how much we see through the climate crazed agenda that is more about DOMINATION and DOLLARS than saving the environment! | | | "ADD YOUR NAME »" | Together, we can ensure that our state remains a beacon of freedom and prosperity, untouched by the heavy hand of government overreach. For Freedom, Todd Watson - Political Director Republican Party of Nebraska | | "PAID FOR BY THE NEBRASKA REPUBLICAN PARTY" | | Copyright © 2023 Nebraska Republican Party, All rights reserved.

| Meet **Mark Walker**

Congressman Mark Walker started his career in finance and, after earning his theology degree, Walker served 16 years as a pastor. In 2014, Walker stepped away from ministry and made a successful run for the U.S. Congress defeating a host of elected politicians. In 2015, Congressman Walker became the first member in an inaugural term to be elected Chair of the Republican Study Committee (RSC) - the largest caucus in Congress with 160 members and a position previously held by Vice President Pence and Congressman Jim Jordan.

In 2018, Walker was elected as Vice Chair of the entire conference, becoming the highest rated conservative to serve in the top four leadership positions in Congress. Walker is also the last member of Congress to secure a floor vote on a balanced budget amendment and led the House on HBCU initiatives winning the United Negro College Fund President’s list award. Congressman Walker served on multiple committees and in 2019, Walker was appointed to ranking member on the Committee on Homeland Security’s Intelligence and Counter-Terrorism’s subcommittee. Walker was co-chair of the bicameral prayer caucus for five years and also won the GOP MVP award as the starting pitcher on the Republican baseball team for the annual charity game.

Congressman Walker was redistricted out of his seat and stepped away from Congress in 2021. Walker ran for U.S. Senate in 2022 and was endorsed by Senators Tim Scott and James Lankford, Gov. Mike Huckabee, Hall of Fame Coach Tony Dungy and more than 200 pastors across North Carolina. Walker is currently the president of a political consulting business called Advancing Hope USA, and advocated for the two North Carolina Supreme Court candidates and 4 North Carolina Court of Appeals candidates through his independent expenditure organization, Win the Courts during this past general election. Congressman Walker and his wife Kelly, a Family Nurse Practitioner and flight trauma specialist, have been married for thirty years and have three children.

She needs to raise $65,000 by midnight on August 31st - this is a daunting task - Peter, we can’t let our radical opponent win, and last cycle she out-fundraised us and almost beat us. We can’t let her bring her radical agenda to Oregon. What do you say Peter, can you donate to Lori’s goal today? Click to donate. Dr. Shawn DeRemer Sent from my iPhone | | | | Even as a Congresswoman, Lori’s most important title is mom. That’s how she knows the issues your family faces, and that’s why she fights everyday to make life better for every Oregon family, and every American. name: Team WFP
subject: Our plan until November
disclaimer_text: Paid for by Working Families Party National PAC (77 Sands St
body:
As families return from summer vacations and children head off to school, we’ll be turning out voters in key races across the country the best way we know how — through phone banks, text banks, canvasses, TV and digital ads, and postcard campaigns. | | | Summer may be almost over, Peter, but election season is heating up. In 5 days, we have a competitive primary to fill Rhode Island’s 1st congressional seat. **We’re throwing our support behind Aaron Regunberg, who just today was endorsed by Rep. Alexandria Ocasio-Cortez!** But that is only the beginning. As we look towards November, we have a chance to make a huge impact at the ballot box all across the country, including:
* In **Virginia** , we’re gearing up for a showdown over the control of the state legislature. With new district lines and only a slim Democratic majority in the Senate, we need to go all out to stop Republicans from winning a trifecta and banning abortion in the state.
* In **Ohio** , we have an opportunity to pass an amendment to the state constitution that would enshrine the right to an abortion.
* In **Arizona** , we can elect two progressives in Tucson who have been a consistent voice for working people.
